photo1.name: photo1.jpg
photo1.title: Vltava River, Prague
photo1.description: The Vltava winding through Prague beneath a moody winter sky, red rooftops scattered like puzzle pieces below.

photo10.name: photo10.jpg
photo10.title: Say Cheese. Wait, Say BOOM
photo10.description: An antique cannon staring you down in a Swiss museum. Still looks ready to ruin someone's afternoon.

photo100.name: photo100.jpg
photo100.title: The Rosetta Stone
photo100.description: The original Google Translate. Still works offline.

photo101.name: photo101.jpg
photo101.title: Golden Galleon
photo101.description: An ornate gilded mechanical ship automaton at the British Museum. 16th century flex.

photo102.name: photo102.jpg
photo102.title: Big Ben Close-Up
photo102.description: Big Ben's clock face glowing in the London night, close enough to check if you're late.

photo104.name: photo104.jpg
photo104.title: Big Ben Looking Up
photo104.description: Elizabeth Tower soaring into the darkness, lit up in warm amber like a medieval lighthouse.

photo105.name: photo105.jpg
photo105.title: Westminster Abbey by Night
photo105.description: Westminster Abbey's Gothic facade illuminated after dark, the towers reaching up into nothing but black sky.

photo106.name: photo106.jpg
photo106.title: Leicester Square
photo106.description: Leicester Square alive at night with the Swiss Glockenspiel clock, M&M's World, LEGO store, and street artists. Sensory overload.

photo107.name: photo107.jpg
photo107.title: Regent Street Angels
photo107.description: Glittering angel light installations spreading their wings over Regent Street during London's Christmas season.

photo109.name: photo109.jpg
photo109.title: Royal Albert Hall
photo109.description: The Royal Albert Hall basking in perfect autumn sunlight. The one time London cooperated with the weather.

photo11.name: photo11.jpg
photo11.title: Jet d'Eau, Geneva
photo11.description: Geneva's iconic Jet d'Eau shooting 140 meters into an overcast sky over Lake Geneva. Nature's biggest flex is still man-made.

photo110.name: photo110.jpg
photo110.title: Kensington Red Brick
photo110.description: Red brick Victorian mansion blocks near Kensington, stacked gables catching the afternoon sun.

photo111.name: photo111.jpg
photo111.title: Royal Albert Hall Up Close
photo111.description: The terracotta frieze and arched windows of the Royal Albert Hall curving against a deep blue sky.

photo112.name: photo112.jpg
photo112.title: Albert Memorial
photo112.description: The Albert Memorial in Kensington Gardens, gilded and Gothic, a love letter frozen in gold and stone.

photo113.name: photo113.jpg
photo113.title: Albert and the Hall
photo113.description: The Albert Memorial framed through autumn trees with the Royal Albert Hall peeking behind. Two for one.

photo114.name: photo114.jpg
photo114.title: Royal Albert Hall Dome
photo114.description: The glass dome of the Royal Albert Hall through autumn leaves, Union Jack flying proudly.

photo115.name: photo115.jpg
photo115.title: Kensington Palace
photo115.description: Kensington Palace across its manicured gardens with Queen Victoria's statue standing guard.

photo116.name: photo116.jpg
photo116.title: Garden Tunnel
photo116.description: A vine-covered walkway tunnel in the Kensington Palace gardens. Got lost. Found this. Worth it.

photo117.name: photo117.jpg
photo117.title: Westminster Abbey Sunlit
photo117.description: Westminster Abbey in full sun with Big Ben lurking in the background. London on its best behavior.

photo118.name: photo118.jpg
photo118.title: Big Ben by Day
photo118.description: Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament looking up from the base, blue sky stretching behind the Elizabeth Tower.

photo12.name: photo12.jpg
photo12.title: Geneva Rooftops
photo12.description: A bird's-eye view down into Geneva's Old Town, all weathered tile roofs and narrow cobblestone streets.

photo120.name: photo120.jpg
photo120.title: Abbey High Altar
photo120.description: The ornate high altar screen of Westminster Abbey, gold and green mosaics gleaming beneath Gothic arches.

photo121.name: photo121.jpg
photo121.title: Abbey Choir
photo121.description: The soaring nave of Westminster Abbey, checkered floor leading through golden choir stalls into infinite Gothic depth.

photo122.name: photo122.jpg
photo122.title: Abbey Altar Detail
photo122.description: The High Altar of Westminster Abbey with its mosaic Last Supper panel flanked by red roses and golden tracery.

photo123.name: photo123.jpg
photo123.title: Henry VII Chapel Ceiling
photo123.description: The jaw-dropping fan vault ceiling of the Henry VII Lady Chapel. Medieval engineers were showing off.

photo124.name: photo124.jpg
photo124.title: Fan Vault and Banners
photo124.description: The intricate pendant fan vault of the Henry VII Chapel with heraldic banners hanging below. Pure Gothic grandeur.

photo125.name: photo125.jpg
photo125.title: Banners and Light
photo125.description: Sunlight streaming through the Henry VII Chapel windows, illuminating colorful Knights of the Bath banners against the fan vaulting.

photo126.name: photo126.jpg
photo126.title: Abbey Cloisters
photo126.description: The serene Gothic cloisters of Westminster Abbey, one man sitting alone in centuries of silence.

photo127.name: photo127.jpg
photo127.title: Abbey Nave
photo127.description: The grand nave of Westminster Abbey with the Tomb of the Unknown Warrior in the foreground, draped in poppies.

photo128.name: photo128.jpg
photo128.title: Methodist Central Hall Sunlit
photo128.description: Methodist Central Hall Westminster bathed in autumn sunshine, its Baroque dome golden against gathering clouds.

photo129.name: photo129.jpg
photo129.title: Westminster Spires
photo129.description: Big Ben and the Westminster skyline layered with Gothic spires and the Union Jack. Aggressively British.

photo13.name: photo13.jpg
photo13.title: No Swimming Allowed
photo13.description: A dock on Lake Geneva with a very firm 'no jumping or swimming' sign. In French, so it sounds fancier.

photo130.name: photo130.jpg
photo130.title: Elbphilharmonie Stairs
photo130.description: The futuristic escalator stairwell inside Hamburg's Elbphilharmonie, all concrete angles and purple porthole lights.

photo131.name: photo131.jpg
photo131.title: Through the Porthole
photo131.description: A medieval turret and courtyard of the Swiss National Museum in Zurich, framed through a circular concrete window.

photo132.name: photo132.jpg
photo132.title: Renaissance Globe
photo132.description: A massive hand-painted antique globe on an ornate stand at the Swiss National Museum. Before GPS, there was this.

photo133.name: photo133.jpg
photo133.title: Swiss Federal Banner
photo133.description: A historic Swiss federal banner with cantonal coats of arms circling the white cross on red. Peak Swiss.

photo134.name: photo134.jpg
photo134.title: Federal Palace Model
photo134.description: A pristine white scale model of the Swiss Federal Palace in Bern, displayed at the Swiss National Museum.

photo135.name: photo135.jpg
photo135.title: Pike Forest
photo135.description: A dramatic display of historical Swiss pikes and polearms reaching toward the ceiling. The original stick collection.

photo136.name: photo136.jpg
photo136.title: Swiss Wood Paneling
photo136.description: A warm wood-paneled room with medieval stained glass windows inside the Swiss National Museum. Cozy dungeon energy.

photo137.name: photo137.jpg
photo137.title: Museum Staircase
photo137.description: A beautiful wooden spiral staircase with turned balusters and herringbone parquet floors. Craftsmanship from another era.

photo138.name: photo138.jpg
photo138.title: Vaulted Gallery
photo138.description: A grand vaulted exhibition hall at the Swiss National Museum with purple-lit display cases beneath ribbed Gothic ceilings.

photo139.name: photo139.jpg
photo139.title: Inside the Duomo
photo139.description: The cavernous nave of Milan's Duomo, massive stone columns dwarfing the visitors below. Genuinely humbling.

photo14.name: photo14.jpg
photo14.title: Broken Chair, UN Geneva
photo14.description: The Broken Chair sculpture standing tall in front of the United Nations in Geneva, a monument against landmines surrounded by the flags of the world.

photo140.name: photo140.jpg
photo140.title: Beneath the Duomo
photo140.description: Ancient Roman and early Christian ruins excavated beneath Milan Cathedral. A city stacked on centuries.

photo141.name: photo141.jpg
photo141.title: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele
photo141.description: The grand entrance arch of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan at dusk, the world's oldest shopping mall still going strong.

photo142.name: photo142.jpg
photo142.title: Inside the Galleria
photo142.description: The glass-vaulted arcade of Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Chanel on the right, a thousand selfies in progress.

photo143.name: photo143.jpg
photo143.title: Castello Sforzesco
photo143.description: Castello Sforzesco's tower emerging through the fog behind illuminated fountains. Milan doing moody better than London.

photo144.name: photo144.jpg
photo144.title: Castle Courtyard at Night
photo144.description: The inner courtyard of Castello Sforzesco on a foggy night, vine-covered pergola glowing green under the haze.

photo145.name: photo145.jpg
photo145.title: Sforza Castle Courtyard
photo145.description: The courtyard of Castello Sforzesco at night, perfectly mirrored in the reflecting pool. Milan knows how to light a castle.

photo146.name: photo146.jpg
photo146.title: San Lorenzo by Night
photo146.description: Basilica di San Lorenzo Maggiore glowing under the Milan night sky, with the statue of Emperor Constantine standing guard out front.

photo147.name: photo147.jpg
photo147.title: Duomo di Milano
photo147.description: The Milan Cathedral in all its Gothic glory. Took 600 years to build, and honestly it shows -- in the best way possible.

photo148.name: photo148.jpg
photo148.title: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
photo148.description: The entrance to Italy's oldest active shopping gallery. Fancy shopping mall energy since 1877.

photo149.name: photo149.jpg
photo149.title: Duomo Rooftop Spires
photo149.description: Walking among the spires on top of Milan's Duomo. Every single one of these has a statue on top, which is absolutely unhinged commitment to detail.

photo15.name: photo15.jpg
photo15.title: Swiss Village Street
photo15.description: A quiet Swiss street with traditional houses, red shutters, and yellow-red painted window frames. Storybook vibes.

photo150.name: photo150.jpg
photo150.title: View from the Duomo
photo150.description: Looking down through the Duomo's spires at the Palazzo Reale below. The people look like ants, which means I climbed too many stairs.

photo151.name: photo151.jpg
photo151.title: Rooftop Tourists
photo151.description: Everyone on the Duomo rooftop doing the exact same thing: taking photos of other people taking photos.

photo152.name: photo152.jpg
photo152.title: Duomo Museum Interior
photo152.description: Inside the Duomo Museum, where the vaulted pink ceilings and frescoes make you feel severely underdressed in a hoodie.

photo153.name: photo153.jpg
photo153.title: Duomo in Miniature
photo153.description: An incredibly detailed wooden scale model of the Duomo. Someone carved this entire thing by hand. I can barely center a div.

photo154.name: photo154.jpg
photo154.title: Santa Maria delle Grazie
photo154.description: The church that houses The Last Supper. Looked humble from the outside. Absolute flex on the inside.

photo155.name: photo155.jpg
photo155.title: The Last Supper
photo155.description: Da Vinci's Last Supper, in person. You get exactly 15 minutes with it. No pressure.

photo156.name: photo156.jpg
photo156.title: Santa Maria Side View
photo156.description: Santa Maria delle Grazie from the side, showing off Bramante's Renaissance dome against a perfect blue sky.

photo157.name: photo157.jpg
photo157.title: Sant'Ambrogio Courtyard
photo157.description: The atrium of the Basilica di Sant'Ambrogio in Milan, bathed in late afternoon light. One of the oldest churches in the city.

photo158.name: photo158.jpg
photo158.title: Divine Light
photo158.description: Sunbeams cutting through the nave of Sant'Ambrogio like a Renaissance painting come to life.

photo159.name: photo159.jpg
photo159.title: Ponte di Castelvecchio
photo159.description: The medieval Castelvecchio Bridge stretching across the Adige River in Verona. Built in 1356 and still looking better than most modern bridges.

photo16.name: photo16.jpg
photo16.title: Schloss Arbon Museum
photo16.description: The Schloss Arbon Museum with its signature red shutters and stepped gable roofline against a blue Swiss sky.

photo160.name: photo160.jpg
photo160.title: Arena di Verona
photo160.description: Street scene by the Arena di Verona -- a Roman amphitheater casually sitting next to a Louis Vuitton store. 2000 years of commerce in one frame.

photo161.name: photo161.jpg
photo161.title: Juliet's Balcony
photo161.description: The famous balcony from Romeo and Juliet in Verona. Shakespeare never actually came here, but don't tell the tourists.

photo162.name: photo162.jpg
photo162.title: Verona Archway
photo162.description: A brick archway with a hanging lantern in old Verona. The kind of alley that makes you feel like you accidentally walked into a period film.

photo163.name: photo163.jpg
photo163.title: Adige River, Verona
photo163.description: Castel San Pietro on the hill above the Adige River on a moody autumn day in Verona.

photo164.name: photo164.jpg
photo164.title: Verona Duck
photo164.description: This mallard was staring me down on the river wall like I owed him rent money. He might own Verona.

photo165.name: photo165.jpg
photo165.title: Overcast Verona
photo165.description: The Adige River under gray skies, with the Santuario della Madonna di Lourdes visible on the hilltop. Verona on a cloudy day still hits different.

photo166.name: photo166.jpg
photo166.title: Colorful Verona Steps
photo166.description: Climbing narrow stepped streets between orange and terracotta buildings. The kind of cardio that doesn't feel like cardio.

photo167.name: photo167.jpg
photo167.title: Verona Hilltop View
photo167.description: Rooftops and cypress trees framing the Adige River from the hillside above Verona. Worth every step.

photo168.name: photo168.jpg
photo168.title: Along the Adige
photo168.description: The quiet curve of the Adige River with a domed church in the distance. Verona from its more contemplative angle.

photo169.name: photo169.jpg
photo169.title: Christmas Lights, Switzerland
photo169.description: A Swiss pedestrian street draped in shooting-star Christmas lights. Europe in December is basically a Hallmark movie set.

photo17.name: photo17.jpg
photo17.title: Bell Tower in Autumn
photo17.description: A church bell tower peeking above the autumn canopy somewhere in the Swiss countryside.

photo170.name: photo170.jpg
photo170.title: Christmas Tree Close-up
photo170.description: A lit Christmas tree on a European street corner. Tilted the camera for artistic effect. Definitely on purpose.

photo171.name: photo171.jpg
photo171.title: Snowy Night
photo171.description: First snow of the season blanketing everything outside. The kind of night where you stay in and write code by the window.

photo172.name: photo172.jpg
photo172.title: Placa de Catalunya
photo172.description: The Francesc Macia monument at Placa de Catalunya in Barcelona. It looks like someone stacked a building upside down, and I respect that.

photo173.name: photo173.jpg
photo173.title: Castell de Montjuic
photo173.description: The fortress walls of Montjuic Castle in Barcelona, flying the Catalan flag. They really knew how to pick a hilltop.

photo174.name: photo174.jpg
photo174.title: Barcelona Port
photo174.description: Barcelona's industrial port from above Montjuic. Container ships, cranes, and the Mediterranean stretching to infinity.

photo175.name: photo175.jpg
photo175.title: Barcelona Panorama
photo175.description: The entire city of Barcelona spread out below Montjuic with wildflowers in the foreground. Not a bad office view.

photo176.name: photo176.jpg
photo176.title: MNAC Towers
photo176.description: The towers and dome of the Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya peeking through the trees on Montjuic hill.

photo177.name: photo177.jpg
photo177.title: Olympic Park, Barcelona
photo177.description: The Calatrava telecommunications tower and Olympic Ring area on Montjuic. Still has that '92 Games energy.

photo178.name: photo178.jpg
photo178.title: Estadi Olimpic
photo178.description: The Olympic Stadium of Montjuic, home of the 1992 Barcelona Olympics. If these walls could talk, they'd probably just say 'faster.'

photo179.name: photo179.jpg
photo179.title: Olympic Columns
photo179.description: Towering columns along the Olympic esplanade in Barcelona. Very imposing. Excellent for feeling small.

photo18.name: photo18.jpg
photo18.title: Swan on the Lake
photo18.description: A mute swan gliding across glassy water with the quiet confidence of someone who knows they're photogenic.

photo180.name: photo180.jpg
photo180.title: Calatrava Tower
photo180.description: Looking straight up at the Montjuic Communications Tower. Calatrava really said 'what if a sundial but make it massive.'

photo181.name: photo181.jpg
photo181.title: Poble Espanyol
photo181.description: The Spanish Village open-air museum in Barcelona, recreating architecture from across Spain. Charming stairs, charming people, charming everything.

photo183.name: photo183.jpg
photo183.title: Medieval Chapel
photo183.description: A small Romanesque chapel inside Poble Espanyol with ancient frescoes on the apse. Quiet and golden.

photo184.name: photo184.jpg
photo184.title: Purple Alley
photo184.description: An alleyway in Poble Espanyol lit up in purple and blue with festive string lights. Looks like a medieval rave.

photo185.name: photo185.jpg
photo185.title: Arenas de Barcelona
photo185.description: The old Les Arenes bullring in Barcelona, now a shopping center. Lit up at night, it looks like a Moorish colosseum. Peak adaptive reuse.

photo186.name: photo186.jpg
photo186.title: Barcelona Cathedral
photo186.description: The Gothic cathedral of Barcelona illuminated at night with holiday lights strung across the plaza. People just vibing on the steps.

photo187.name: photo187.jpg
photo187.title: Sagrada Familia Side
photo187.description: The Passion facade of the Sagrada Familia, all angular and skeletal. Gaudi's masterpiece, still under construction after 140+ years. Agile development before it was cool.

photo188.name: photo188.jpg
photo188.title: Sagrada Familia Front
photo188.description: The Nativity facade of the Sagrada Familia, dripping with organic detail. It looks like a cathedral grew out of the earth.

photo189.name: photo189.jpg
photo189.title: Sagrada Familia Ceiling
photo189.description: Looking straight up inside the Sagrada Familia. The columns branch like trees and the ceiling feels alive. My neck still hurts.

photo19.name: photo19.jpg
photo19.title: Stein am Rhein Gate
photo19.description: Half-timbered buildings and a painted clock tower marking the entrance to Stein am Rhein's medieval old town.

photo190.name: photo190.jpg
photo190.title: Sagrada Familia Nave
photo190.description: The interior of the Sagrada Familia, a forest of stone columns lit by kaleidoscopic stained glass. Photos cannot do this justice.

photo192.name: photo192.jpg
photo192.title: Sagrada Familia Towers
photo192.description: The Nativity facade towers of the Sagrada Familia up close, with construction cranes still hard at work. Estimated completion: eventually.

photo193.name: photo193.jpg
photo193.title: Barcelona Cafe
photo193.description: A cozy cafe interior in Barcelona with a wooden table, dried flowers, and a view of the street. Perfect for pretending to be a local.

photo194.name: photo194.jpg
photo194.title: Bellinzona Street
photo194.description: A pedestrian shopping street in Bellinzona, Switzerland, with the Alps visible in the background. Mountains at the end of every street.

photo195.name: photo195.jpg
photo195.title: Castelgrande Tower
photo195.description: The medieval tower and walls of Castelgrande rising above the rooftops of Bellinzona. Switzerland has castles too, apparently.

photo196.name: photo196.jpg
photo196.title: Castelgrande Rock Face
photo196.description: Castelgrande perched on its massive rock outcrop in Bellinzona. The medieval equivalent of building your house on a cliff for the views.

photo197.name: photo197.jpg
photo197.title: Church in Bellinzona
photo197.description: The Collegiate Church of Saints Peter and Stephen in Bellinzona, a handsome Renaissance facade framed by the Swiss Alps.

photo2.name: photo2.jpg
photo2.title: Vysehrad Twin Spires
photo2.description: The twin Gothic spires of the Basilica of St. Peter and St. Paul at Vysehrad, glowing warm against the Prague dusk.

photo20.name: photo20.jpg
photo20.title: Stein am Rhein Square
photo20.description: The main square of Stein am Rhein, lined with frescoed half-timbered houses, a fountain, and cobblestones worn smooth by centuries.

photo200.name: photo200.jpg
photo200.title: Castelgrande Courtyard
photo200.description: The twin towers and courtyard of Castelgrande with snow-capped mountains behind. A couple sitting on the lawn, living their best medieval life.

photo201.name: photo201.jpg
photo201.title: Castle Wall Walk
photo201.description: Walking the ramparts of Castelgrande in Bellinzona, with the tower and Alpine foothills in view. Feeling very Game of Thrones.

photo202.name: photo202.jpg
photo202.title: Montebello from Above
photo202.description: Castello di Montebello and its connecting walls seen from up high, snaking across the hillside like a stone spine.

photo203.name: photo203.jpg
photo203.title: Bellinzona from the Tower
photo203.description: An aerial view of Castelgrande's tower and the town of Bellinzona below, nestled in the alpine valley.

photo204.name: photo204.jpg
photo204.title: Bellinzona Battlements
photo204.description: The castle walls stretching between Bellinzona's fortresses with autumn mountains as the backdrop. UNESCO World Heritage vibes.

photo205.name: photo205.jpg
photo205.title: Castle Wall Overlook
photo205.description: Walking the castle walls with a view over Bellinzona and the surrounding valley. The merlons cast perfect shadows on the green walkway.

photo206.name: photo206.jpg
photo206.title: Bellinzona Church Interior
photo206.description: The ornate interior of a Bellinzona church, every surface covered in frescoes. They really didn't believe in blank walls.

photo207.name: photo207.jpg
photo207.title: Lugano Waterfront
photo207.description: Golden hour on the Lugano lakefront with pedal boats and elegant buildings. Swiss-Italian lake town perfection.

photo208.name: photo208.jpg
photo208.title: Lake Lugano
photo208.description: Mountains rising from Lake Lugano like a postcard that's trying too hard. Except it's real and it's effortless.

photo209.name: photo209.jpg
photo209.title: Lugano Sunset
photo209.description: Sunset over Lake Lugano, a lone boat floating in the silky water. The kind of moment you just stand there for.

photo21.name: photo21.jpg
photo21.title: Clock Tower Gateway
photo21.description: Stein am Rhein's iconic clock tower gate framed by half-timbered buildings and bustling shops. Feels like walking into a medieval RPG.

photo210.name: photo210.jpg
photo210.title: Sentiero di Gandria
photo210.description: The trailhead sign for the Sentiero di Gandria path along Lake Lugano. The hike was worth it. The sign was photogenic enough on its own.

photo211.name: photo211.jpg
photo211.title: Lugano at Dusk
photo211.description: Lake Lugano at twilight, the sky shifting from purple to gold behind the mountain silhouettes. Easily the best screensaver I've ever taken.

photo212.name: photo212.jpg
photo212.title: Giant Ornament
photo212.description: A massive walk-through Christmas ornament made of lights in a Lugano town square. Finally, the ornament-to-human ratio I've always wanted.

photo213.name: photo213.jpg
photo213.title: Lugano Night Alley
photo213.description: A narrow Lugano alley at night with shops and string lights climbing the steep steps. Cozy doesn't begin to cover it.

photo214.name: photo214.jpg
photo214.title: Natale in Citta
photo214.description: Castelgrande lit up at night with 'Natale in Citta' projected onto the cliff face. Bellinzona going all out for Christmas.

photo215.name: photo215.jpg
photo215.title: Zurich Christmas Market
photo215.description: The Zurich Opera House presiding over a packed Christmas market. Gluehwein in hand, lights overhead, zero complaints.

photo216.name: photo216.jpg
photo216.title: Swiss Alps Cable Car
photo216.description: Snow-covered Swiss Alps with cable car lines disappearing into the peaks. The real world has better render distance than any game.

photo217.name: photo217.jpg
photo217.title: Top of Santis
photo217.description: The observation deck at Santis summit. Standing above the clouds with an entire country sprawling below you hits different.

photo219.name: photo219.jpg
photo219.title: Alpine Sea of Peaks
photo219.description: Endless snow-covered Swiss Alps stretching to the horizon from the Santis summit. This is what 2500 meters of altitude buys you.

photo22.name: photo22.jpg
photo22.title: Church on the Hill
photo22.description: A white church with a green copper steeple nestled into the Swiss hillside, a ruined fortress watching over it from above.

photo220.name: photo220.jpg
photo220.title: Cable Car Descent
photo220.description: Riding the cable car back down from Santis, watching the snow-dusted villages and pine forests grow closer.

photo221.name: photo221.jpg
photo221.title: Peak Through the Pines
photo221.description: A massive Alpine peak framed perfectly by evergreen trees. Nature really said 'let me compose this for you.'

photo222.name: photo222.jpg
photo222.title: Forest Trail Opening
photo222.description: A snowy forest path opens to a clearing with hikers in the distance. The kind of scene that makes you forget about deadlines.

photo223.name: photo223.jpg
photo223.title: Mountain Through Trees
photo223.description: Snow-capped Swiss peak towering above a pine forest, with a single wispy cloud slicing across the blue sky.

photo224.name: photo224.jpg
photo224.title: Sunlit Snow Path
photo224.description: Dappled sunlight filtering through Alpine conifers onto a snowy trail. Peaceful enough to hear your own heartbeat.

photo225.name: photo225.jpg
photo225.title: Rocky Alpine Terrain
photo225.description: Snow-dusted boulders scattered across an Alpine slope with peaks in the background. Geology students would lose it here.

photo226.name: photo226.jpg
photo226.title: Santis Transmitter Tower
photo226.description: The Santis weather station and transmitter perched dramatically on jagged cliffs. Whoever maintains that tower deserves a raise.

photo227.name: photo227.jpg
photo227.title: Forest and Cliff Face
photo227.description: Tall pines dwarfed by a sheer Alpine cliff wall dusted in snow. Scale is hard to convey but trust me, that rock face is enormous.

photo228.name: photo228.jpg
photo228.title: Appenzell Railway
photo228.description: A bright red Appenzell Railways train pulling into a snowy station. Swiss public transit remains undefeated.

photo229.name: photo229.jpg
photo229.title: Appenzell Main Street
photo229.description: Colorful painted facades and holiday decorations lining the pedestrian street in Appenzell. The Ofenkartoffeln sign is calling my name.

photo23.name: photo23.jpg
photo23.title: Rooftops and Flags
photo23.description: A tangle of half-timbered rooftops and cantonal flags in Stein am Rhein. Every building here is older than my entire country.

photo230.name: photo230.jpg
photo230.title: Swiss Museum Interior
photo230.description: An ornate green tile stove, carved wooden cabinet, and a merman sculpture hanging from the ceiling. Normal museum things.

photo232.name: photo232.jpg
photo232.title: Baroque Church Interior
photo232.description: Gilded altars, painted ceilings, and stained glass inside a stunning Swiss baroque church. They really did not hold back on the gold leaf.

photo233.name: photo233.jpg
photo233.title: Lausanne Cathedral
photo233.description: The Gothic towers of Lausanne Cathedral rising above bare winter branches against a dramatic cloudy sky.

photo235.name: photo235.jpg
photo235.title: Cathedral Organ Player
photo235.description: An organist performing on a massive pipe organ inside the cathedral while tourists watch in awe. Free concert with your admission.

photo236.name: photo236.jpg
photo236.title: Lausanne Harbor
photo236.description: Sailboats tucked under winter covers at the marina on Lake Geneva, with gulls bobbing on the grey water.

photo237.name: photo237.jpg
photo237.title: Eole Sculpture
photo237.description: The Eole wind sculpture at Ouchy harbor, a giant crescent sail shape rising from the breakwater on Lake Geneva.

photo238.name: photo238.jpg
photo238.title: Olympic Countdown
photo238.description: The Omega Olympic countdown clock in Lausanne, ticking away next to a restaurant called Le Pirate. An unlikely duo.

photo239.name: photo239.jpg
photo239.title: Olympic Museum Sign
photo239.description: The Musee Olympique entrance sign in Lausanne. Had to visit the HQ of the organization that makes me feel inadequate at sports.

photo24.name: photo24.jpg
photo24.title: Overgrown Steps
photo24.description: Got lost. Found this. Worth it.

photo240.name: photo240.jpg
photo240.title: Winged Victory Reimagined
photo240.description: A striking Nike of Samothrace reinterpretation draped in colorful flags, suspended in the atrium of the Olympic Museum.

photo241.name: photo241.jpg
photo241.title: Olympic Torch Collection
photo241.description: Every Olympic torch ever designed, lined up in a glowing curved gallery. Some are elegant, some look like plumbing fixtures.

photo242.name: photo242.jpg
photo242.title: Lake Geneva Bench
photo242.description: A lone bench overlooking the hazy expanse of Lake Geneva from the Olympic Museum terrace. Best seat in Lausanne.

photo243.name: photo243.jpg
photo243.title: Alps from Lausanne
photo243.description: Snow-capped peaks visible across the rooftops of Lausanne at dusk, with autumn foliage still clinging on.

photo244.name: photo244.jpg
photo244.title: Lausanne Night Alley
photo244.description: A neon-lit cobblestone alley in Lausanne's old town with palm trees and La Grappilleuse boutique. Surprisingly tropical for Switzerland.

photo246.name: photo246.jpg
photo246.title: Midnight on the Lake
photo246.description: A pier stretching into the dark waters of Lake Geneva at night, city lights glowing on the far shore. Long exposure photography at its finest.

photo247.name: photo247.jpg
photo247.title: Lake Geneva After Dark
photo247.description: The distant glow of lakeside towns reflected on the impossibly still surface of Lake Geneva. Just me and a trillion photons.

photo248.name: photo248.jpg
photo248.title: Lausanne Waterfront Night
photo248.description: City lights reflecting off Lake Geneva's shore at night, with illuminated buildings lining the waterfront promenade.

photo25.name: photo25.jpg
photo25.title: Twilight Over Stein am Rhein
photo25.description: The town of Stein am Rhein glowing softly at dusk, seen from the hilltop fortress. The Rhine snakes past on the left.

photo250.name: photo250.jpg
photo250.title: Basel Christmas Tree
photo250.description: A towering Christmas tree glittering with lights in front of the Basel Munster cathedral. The holiday spirit was strong with this one.

photo251.name: photo251.jpg
photo251.title: Gluhwein Stand
photo251.description: A cozy Gluhwein and Kartoffel Chips stand at the Basel Christmas market. The two Swiss food groups during winter.

photo252.name: photo252.jpg
photo252.title: Matterhorn from Zermatt
photo252.description: The iconic Matterhorn peeking over the rooftops of Zermatt village, with the Swiss flag and Gemeinde Bibliothek below. Not a bad library view.

photo253.name: photo253.jpg
photo253.title: The Matterhorn
photo253.description: The Matterhorn in all its pyramidal glory, clouds swirling around the peak. The Toblerone mountain in the flesh.

photo254.name: photo254.jpg
photo254.title: Zermatt Valley Chalets
photo254.description: Snow-covered wooden chalets nestled in the Zermatt valley with towering peaks on either side. Real life looks like a postcard here.

photo255.name: photo255.jpg
photo255.title: Swiss White Horse
photo255.description: A white horse staring directly into my camera over a wooden fence. This horse has more confidence than I ever will.

photo256.name: photo256.jpg
photo256.title: Matterhorn Through Trees
photo256.description: The Matterhorn framed by bare winter larch trees under a blue sky. You really can see it from everywhere in Zermatt.

photo257.name: photo257.jpg
photo257.title: Gornergrat Railway Track
photo257.description: Snow-lined tracks of the Gornergrat railway curving toward the mountains near Zermatt. The most scenic commute imaginable.

photo259.name: photo259.jpg
photo259.title: Alpine Village in Fog
photo259.description: A string of wooden chalets along a snowy mountainside disappearing into the fog. The silence up here is almost loud.

photo260.name: photo260.jpg
photo260.title: Snowfall at the Chalets
photo260.description: Heavy snow falling on rustic stone and timber chalets with a ski lift passing overhead. Peak Swiss winter vibes.

photo261.name: photo261.jpg
photo261.title: Sunnegga Buffet Bar
photo261.description: Skiers and snowboarders gathering outside the Buffet Bar Sunnegga in a blizzard. Nothing stops the Swiss from hitting the slopes.

photo262.name: photo262.jpg
photo262.title: Sunnegga Funicular Tunnel
photo262.description: The funicular tunnel at Sunnegga station, tracks disappearing into the mountain. Basically a real-life loading screen.

photo263.name: photo263.jpg
photo263.title: Snowy Zermatt Main Street
photo263.description: Zermatt's car-free main street in a snowstorm, lined with Raiffeisenbank, Breitling, and Swiss Chalet restaurant. Luxury shopping in a blizzard.

photo264.name: photo264.jpg
photo264.title: Zermatt After Snowfall
photo264.description: Zermatt village square at night blanketed in fresh snow, buildings glowing warm through the winter haze.

photo265.name: photo265.jpg
photo265.title: Zermatt Christmas Tree
photo265.description: A snow-covered Christmas tree lit with blue-white lights in the center of Zermatt, falling snow caught in the glow.

photo266.name: photo266.jpg
photo266.title: Winterthur Boulevard
photo266.description: A wide pedestrian boulevard in Winterthur with star-shaped holiday lights strung overhead and colorful Swiss buildings on each side.

photo268.name: photo268.jpg
photo268.title: Painted Church Interior
photo268.description: Vivid biblical murals covering every surface of a Swiss church interior, from arches to apse. Medieval artists went absolutely hard.

photo269.name: photo269.jpg
photo269.title: SBB Train Station
photo269.description: The grand facade of a Swiss SBB railway station, complete with domed towers and the Swiss flag. Architecture that takes trains seriously.

photo27.name: photo27.jpg
photo27.title: Cathedral Light
photo27.description: Sunlight pouring through the rear window of Basel Minster, organ pipes framing the glow like a stage curtain.

photo270.name: photo270.jpg
photo270.title: Winterthur Christmas Market
photo270.description: Crowds browsing a bustling Christmas market with wooden stalls and festive decorations. Everyone is bundled up and nobody is complaining.

photo271.name: photo271.jpg
photo271.title: Winterthur Overlook
photo271.description: A grey-sky panorama over the rooftops of Winterthur, with a church steeple and bare winter branches framing the view.

photo272.name: photo272.jpg
photo272.title: ZHAW Campus
photo272.description: The neoclassical ZHAW university building in Winterthur. CS students study in style over here.

photo273.name: photo273.jpg
photo273.title: Zurich Limmat View
photo273.description: The Limmat River winding through Zurich's old town at dusk, church spires and white buildings reflecting in the water.

photo274.name: photo274.jpg
photo274.title: Zurich Trams at Dusk
photo274.description: Two Zurich trams side by side near Bahnhofstrasse with holiday lights twinkling overhead. Line 13 to Albisgutli, if you're curious.

photo275.name: photo275.jpg
photo275.title: Misty Alpine Village
photo275.description: A green valley village with low-hanging clouds wrapping around snowy peaks above. The kind of moody weather that makes everything more photogenic.

photo276.name: photo276.jpg
photo276.title: Hillside Chapel
photo276.description: A tiny stone chapel with a bell tower sitting alone on a mossy green hillside between ancient trees. Definitely a save point in a video game.

photo277.name: photo277.jpg
photo277.title: Gruyeres Main Street
photo277.description: The medieval cobblestone main street of Gruyeres bustling with visitors, Hotel Le Saint Georges on the left, mountains hiding behind the clouds.

photo278.name: photo278.jpg
photo278.title: HR Giger Museum
photo278.description: A wall of sculpted baby faces at the HR Giger Museum in Gruyeres. The man who designed Alien lived in cheese country. What a world.

photo280.name: photo280.jpg
photo280.title: Gruyeres Church in Fog
photo280.description: The white church of Gruyeres rising from the mist with snow-capped mountains barely visible behind. Moody and magnificent.

photo281.name: photo281.jpg
photo281.title: Gruyeres Castle Walls
photo281.description: The medieval fortification walls and towers of Gruyeres emerging from dense fog, gnarled trees standing guard. Straight out of a gothic novel.

photo282.name: photo282.jpg
photo282.title: Valley in the Mist
photo282.description: A birds-eye view of a Swiss valley village completely blanketed in fog, red rooftops poking through the grey. Navigation by faith alone.

photo283.name: photo283.jpg
photo283.title: Castle de Gruyeres
photo283.description: The Castle of Gruyeres looming in the fog, with its maze garden in the foreground. Medieval vibes at maximum capacity.

photo284.name: photo284.jpg
photo284.title: Gruyeres in the Rain
photo284.description: A church spire and misty mountains viewed from the castle ramparts of Gruyeres. Even in bad weather, this place is stunning.

photo285.name: photo285.jpg
photo285.title: Gruyeres Blue Hour
photo285.description: The medieval main street of Gruyeres aglow with Christmas market stalls and warm lights under a deep blue twilight sky.

photo286.name: photo286.jpg
photo286.title: Fog and Light
photo286.description: A Swiss hillside building glowing through thick nighttime fog, silhouetted trees framing the ethereal scene. Giving Silent Hill but make it cozy.

photo287.name: photo287.jpg
photo287.title: Christmas Market from Above
photo287.description: An aerial view of the Gruyeres Christmas market at night, wooden stalls and lit trees filling the cobblestone street between historic hotels.

photo288.name: photo288.jpg
photo288.title: St. Vitus Cathedral, Prague
photo288.description: The dark Gothic spires of St. Vitus Cathedral at Prague Castle piercing the overcast sky. The Czechs said bigger is better and meant it.

photo289.name: photo289.jpg
photo289.title: Prague Castle Courtyard
photo289.description: Tourists milling around the second courtyard of Prague Castle, with its baroque fountain and the Czech flag flying above.

photo29.name: photo29.jpg
photo29.title: Autumn Courtyard
photo29.description: A quiet courtyard bathed in autumn sun, with a pergola and scattered chairs. The kind of spot where you sit and pretend to read.

photo290.name: photo290.jpg
photo290.title: St. Vitus Cathedral
photo290.description: The western facade of St. Vitus Cathedral in Prague, with its twin spires and massive rose window staring you down like a final boss.

photo292.name: photo292.jpg
photo292.title: Golden Gate Mosaics
photo292.description: The south side of St. Vitus Cathedral showing the stunning Last Judgment mosaic on the Golden Gate. Six hundred years old and still the best pixel art in town.

photo293.name: photo293.jpg
photo293.title: Castle Courtyard
photo293.description: The courtyard and gardens near Prague Castle on a quiet overcast day. Free WiFi sign spotted -- even kings needed to check their email.

photo294.name: photo294.jpg
photo294.title: Prague Red Rooftops
photo294.description: A sea of terracotta rooftops stretching across Prague's Mala Strana, viewed from the castle hill. Not a single flat roof in sight.

photo295.name: photo295.jpg
photo295.title: Petrin Lookout Tower
photo295.description: The Petrin Lookout Tower rising above the winter treeline on Petrin Hill. Prague's answer to the Eiffel Tower, built for a fraction of the price.

photo296.name: photo296.jpg
photo296.title: Streets of Mala Strana
photo296.description: Crowds flowing down from Prague Castle through the colorful streets near Sternberg Palace. Signs for trdelnik everywhere, as legally required.

photo297.name: photo297.jpg
photo297.title: Certovka Canal
photo297.description: The narrow Certovka canal (Devil's Stream) winding between old buildings in Mala Strana, with a wooden water wheel barely visible in the shadows.

photo298.name: photo298.jpg
photo298.title: Golden Vltava
photo298.description: Late afternoon sun turning the Vltava River to liquid gold, with a cruise boat drifting past the Smetana Museum and the National Theatre dome in the distance.

photo299.name: photo299.jpg
photo299.title: Bridge Busker Blues
photo299.description: A street musician on Charles Bridge bundled up against the cold, playing a resonator guitar with fingerless gloves. This guy has more style than my entire wardrobe.

photo3.name: photo3.jpg
photo3.title: Painted Vaults
photo3.description: Art Nouveau frescoes sprawl across the vaulted ceiling of the Vysehrad basilica. Someone really committed to the whole 'no blank surfaces' thing.

photo30.name: photo30.jpg
photo30.title: Stone and Autumn Leaves
photo30.description: A handsome stone building draped in golden autumn leaves, arched doorways inviting you inside.

photo300.name: photo300.jpg
photo300.title: Prague Side Street
photo300.description: A narrow cobblestone lane somewhere in Old Town Prague, complete with a Guinness sign, Christmas lights, and a bar advertising free beer. Narrator: it was not free.

photo301.name: photo301.jpg
photo301.title: Wenceslas Square at Night
photo301.description: The National Museum glowing at the end of Wenceslas Square on a winter evening, flanked by golden holiday lights and construction barriers.

photo303.name: photo303.jpg
photo303.title: Head of Franz Kafka
photo303.description: David Cerny's rotating sculpture of Franz Kafka's head in Prague. Forty-two moving layers of stainless steel contemplating the absurdity of existence. Relatable.

photo304.name: photo304.jpg
photo304.title: Butterfly Plane Sculpture
photo304.description: A giant sculpture of a WWII fighter plane with butterfly wings mounted on a building in Prague. Art that makes you do a double take.

photo305.name: photo305.jpg
photo305.title: Prague Museum Facade
photo305.description: An ornate Neo-Renaissance museum building in Prague with green-gold domes, cars and traffic lights competing for attention in the foreground.

photo306.name: photo306.jpg
photo306.title: Wenceslas Overlook
photo306.description: Looking down Wenceslas Square from the steps of the National Museum, past a regal statue and a McDonald's. History meets capitalism.

photo307.name: photo307.jpg
photo307.title: National Museum Grand Staircase
photo307.description: The breathtaking main hall of the Czech National Museum with its red-carpeted staircase, painted ceiling, and gold everywhere. My dorm room could never.

photo309.name: photo309.jpg
photo309.title: Ancient Sea Creatures
photo309.description: A massive marine reptile model diving toward a nautilus in the National Museum's paleontology exhibit. Someone below is on their phone, unfazed by prehistoric death.

photo31.name: photo31.jpg
photo31.title: Cafe Culture
photo31.description: A sunny plaza in a Swiss city, outdoor cafes buzzing with people, the Manta Bar holding it down on the corner.

photo310.name: photo310.jpg
photo310.title: Hall of Minerals
photo310.description: Glass display cases filled with minerals and gemstones in the National Museum. The sign says Hall of Minerals and I want to live here.

photo311.name: photo311.jpg
photo311.title: Museum Ceiling Glory
photo311.description: Looking up at the ornate painted ceiling and marble columns of the National Museum's upper gallery. They really don't make buildings like this anymore.

photo312.name: photo312.jpg
photo312.title: Museum Chandelier
photo312.description: A golden chandelier with globe lights glowing warmly under an arched ceiling in the National Museum. It's just a lamp, but it has more personality than most people.

photo313.name: photo313.jpg
photo313.title: Stained Glass Dome
photo313.description: Looking up at the spectacular stained glass dome ceiling inside the National Museum, with a radiant sun motif at its center.

photo314.name: photo314.jpg
photo314.title: Museum Inner Courtyard
photo314.description: The vast, empty inner courtyard of the National Museum with its glass skylight ceiling and painted frieze. Echo chamber energy.

photo315.name: photo315.jpg
photo315.title: National Museum at Night
photo315.description: The National Museum facade illuminated at night, statues and columns bathed in white light against the dark Prague sky. It hits different after dark.

photo316.name: photo316.jpg
photo316.title: Prague Church at Night
photo316.description: A Gothic church glowing in warm amber light on a winter night in Prague, with a Christmas tree twinkling nearby.

photo317.name: photo317.jpg
photo317.title: Night Chapel
photo317.description: A small chapel lit up at night with a cross on top, a Christmas tree beside it, and a couple of stars visible in the sky.

photo318.name: photo318.jpg
photo318.title: Neon Butterfly
photo318.description: The butterfly plane sculpture lit up in LED purple and pink at night. Somehow even more surreal than during the day.

photo319.name: photo319.jpg
photo319.title: Wenceslas Square by Day
photo319.description: The National Museum presiding over Wenceslas Square on a gray day, construction barriers in the foreground. Prague is always being polished.

photo32.name: photo32.jpg
photo32.title: Statue in the Park
photo32.description: A bronze figure gazes across a green park toward a modern tower, autumn creeping in at the edges.

photo321.name: photo321.jpg
photo321.title: Coral Pink Facade
photo321.description: A massive salmon-pink building with rows of arched windows in Prague. Every window identical. The CSS developer in me appreciates the consistency.

photo322.name: photo322.jpg
photo322.title: Museum Side View
photo322.description: The golden domes of the National Museum seen from the side, with a metro entrance below. Even the subway stops are fancy here.

photo323.name: photo323.jpg
photo323.title: Museum Full Frontal
photo323.description: The National Museum in all its glory, Ukrainian flag hanging between the columns, with the St. Wenceslas statue and vendor stalls below.

photo324.name: photo324.jpg
photo324.title: Prague Skyline Domes
photo324.description: Church domes and spires poking through bare winter trees across the Vltava. Prague's skyline has more spires than my code has semicolons.

photo325.name: photo325.jpg
photo325.title: Vysehrad Gate
photo325.description: The Tabor Gate at Vysehrad fortress, a medieval entrance through old brick walls. Feels like entering a different century.

photo326.name: photo326.jpg
photo326.title: Vysehrad Walls
photo326.description: The fortified walls and hillside of Vysehrad with old Prague buildings and church domes visible above the ramparts.

photo327.name: photo327.jpg
photo327.title: Castle on the Hill
photo327.description: Prague Castle and St. Vitus Cathedral visible across a panorama of orange rooftops. The view from Vysehrad is absolutely worth the climb.

photo328.name: photo328.jpg
photo328.title: Vysehrad Cemetery
photo328.description: Rows of graves decorated with fresh flowers at Vysehrad Cemetery, the final resting place of Dvorak, Mucha, and other Czech legends.

photo329.name: photo329.jpg
photo329.title: Geneva Statue
photo329.description: A bronze statue on a cobblestone square in Geneva, with a Swiss flag visible in the background. Very official. Very neutral.

photo33.name: photo33.jpg
photo33.title: Twin Church Towers
photo33.description: Two church towers side by side against a crisp blue sky, clock faces keeping different kinds of time.

photo330.name: photo330.jpg
photo330.title: Long Room, Trinity College
photo330.description: The legendary Long Room at Trinity College Dublin, with its barrel-vaulted ceiling, marble busts, and a glowing Earth art installation. Hogwarts energy is off the charts.

photo331.name: photo331.jpg
photo331.title: Library Column Detail
photo331.description: Close-up of a Corinthian column capital in Trinity College's Old Library, with the shelving labels visible. Analog database indexing at its finest.

photo332.name: photo332.jpg
photo332.title: Trinity College Quad
photo332.description: The lush green quad of Trinity College Dublin on a perfect summer day, the Campanile bell tower standing guard. Makes me want to transfer.

photo333.name: photo333.jpg
photo333.title: Dublin Fleet Street
photo333.description: A cobblestone street in Dublin near the Palace Bar, people milling about in the afternoon sun. Not a bad spot for a pint.

photo334.name: photo334.jpg
photo334.title: Temple Bar District
photo334.description: The bustling Temple Bar area in Dublin with its colorful pubs, horse-drawn carriage, and international flags. Tourist trap? Maybe. Worth it? Absolutely.

photo335.name: photo335.jpg
photo335.title: Guinness Storehouse Entrance
photo335.description: The entrance to the Guinness Storehouse at St. James's Gate, with a colorful LED bridge overhead. Pilgrimage site for beer enthusiasts.

photo336.name: photo336.jpg
photo336.title: Guinness Industrial Guts
photo336.description: Looking up through the steel beam structure inside the Guinness Storehouse. Industrial architecture meets stained glass vibes.

photo337.name: photo337.jpg
photo337.title: Guinness Colorful Interior
photo337.description: Colorful glass panels and green steel beams inside the Guinness Storehouse, visitors riding the escalator through a kaleidoscope of color.

photo338.name: photo338.jpg
photo338.title: Irish Green Pancakes
photo338.description: Spinach pancakes topped with roasted cherry tomatoes and mushrooms on a blue plate. Ireland really said eat your greens.

photo339.name: photo339.jpg
photo339.title: Gravity Bar Crowd
photo339.description: The Gravity Bar at the top of the Guinness Storehouse, packed with people enjoying their complimentary pint with panoramic views of Dublin.

photo34.name: photo34.jpg
photo34.title: Pastel Town Square
photo34.description: A wide pedestrian square flanked by pastel-colored buildings in Winterthur. Quiet morning energy before the crowds arrive.

photo340.name: photo340.jpg
photo340.title: Guinness and Chill
photo340.description: People gathered around tables at the Gravity Bar with colorful murals behind them. That guy in the green cloak is living his best medieval life.

photo341.name: photo341.jpg
photo341.title: Gravity Bar Views
photo341.description: Another angle of the Gravity Bar crowd at Guinness. Everyone's holding a dark pint and pretending they're not tourists.

photo342.name: photo342.jpg
photo342.title: Guinness Neon Sign
photo342.description: The iconic Guinness neon sign at St. James's Gate Brewery with visitors posing for photos. The harp logo is practically a national symbol.

photo343.name: photo343.jpg
photo343.title: River Liffey Dublin
photo343.description: The River Liffey flowing through Dublin with the Ha'penny Bridge in the distance on a partly cloudy day. Classic Dublin postcard shot.

photo344.name: photo344.jpg
photo344.title: Christ Church Cathedral
photo344.description: Christ Church Cathedral in Dublin, one of the oldest buildings in the city. Nearly a thousand years of standing in Irish rain.

photo345.name: photo345.jpg
photo345.title: Christ Church Interior
photo345.description: The soaring Gothic nave of Christ Church Cathedral, with its pointed arches and soft light filtering through stained glass.

photo346.name: photo346.jpg
photo346.title: Cathedral Lantern
photo346.description: A glass lantern chandelier hanging in Christ Church Cathedral with stained glass windows glowing in the background. Medieval mood lighting.

photo347.name: photo347.jpg
photo347.title: Vaulted Ceiling and Organ
photo347.description: Looking straight up at the ribbed vaulted ceiling of Christ Church Cathedral with the organ pipes peeking in from the left.

photo348.name: photo348.jpg
photo348.title: Christ Church Altar
photo348.description: The beautifully ornate altar and apse of Christ Church Cathedral, with intricate stonework and three stunning stained glass windows.

photo349.name: photo349.jpg
photo349.title: Christ Church Stained Glass
photo349.description: The altar chapel with vivid stained glass windows depicting biblical scenes, a golden cross, and an Irish Celtic cross banner.

photo35.name: photo35.jpg
photo35.title: Sunset Silhouettes
photo35.description: Golden hour turning Swiss rooftops and treetops into dark silhouettes. Sometimes the walk home is the best part of the day.

photo350.name: photo350.jpg
photo350.title: Christ Church in Sunshine
photo350.description: Christ Church Cathedral backlit by afternoon sun with a lens flare. Even the sun wanted to be in this photo.

photo351.name: photo351.jpg
photo351.title: Samuel Beckett Bridge
photo351.description: The harp-shaped Samuel Beckett Bridge spanning the River Liffey in Dublin's docklands. Designed by Calatrava, shaped like Ireland's national symbol.

photo352.name: photo352.jpg
photo352.title: Custom House Dublin
photo352.description: Dublin's Custom House and the Spire visible through the structural beams of a bridge, framing the green copper dome perfectly.

photo353.name: photo353.jpg
photo353.title: Liffey Boardwalk
photo353.description: A sunny stroll along the River Liffey boardwalk with the Custom House dome in the distance and Dublin's cranes on the skyline.

photo354.name: photo354.jpg
photo354.title: Liffey Seagulls
photo354.description: Two seagulls chilling on the concrete embankment of the River Liffey. They own this city and they know it.

photo355.name: photo355.jpg
photo355.title: Seagull on a Lamppost
photo355.description: A seagull landing on a lamppost along the Liffey boardwalk, wings spread wide. This is his lamppost. You're just visiting.

photo356.name: photo356.jpg
photo356.title: Liffey Tree-Lined Walk
photo356.description: Sun-dappled trees lining the walkway along the River Liffey with lens flare sneaking through the leaves. Dublin on a good weather day is unbeatable.

photo357.name: photo357.jpg
photo357.title: Oscar Wilde Statue
photo357.description: The Oscar Wilde statue lounging on a boulder in Merrion Square, Dublin, with literary quotes on the pillar beside him. Still judging passersby after all these years.

photo358.name: photo358.jpg
photo358.title: Dublin Park Benches
photo358.description: A quiet corner of a Dublin park with stone benches, arched walls, and an ancient tree with a hollow trunk. Peaceful enough to finally finish that homework.

photo359.name: photo359.jpg
photo359.title: St. Stephen's Green Bridge
photo359.description: A stone footbridge over the pond in St. Stephen's Green, surrounded by lush greenery and dappled light. An impossibly peaceful spot in the middle of Dublin.

photo36.name: photo36.jpg
photo36.title: The Founding Fathers
photo36.description: Three stern stone figures guarding the entrance of the Swiss Federal Palace in Bern. They've been standing there so long they've earned the right to judge.

photo360.name: photo360.jpg
photo360.title: Park Portrait Mode
photo360.description: A juvenile herring gull posing on a rock in St. Stephen's Green with perfect bokeh behind it. Honestly, better portraits than most LinkedIn headshots.

photo361.name: photo361.jpg
photo361.title: St. Stephen's Green Pond
photo361.description: The reflecting pool and gardens of St. Stephen's Green on a calm evening, trees in every shade of green surrounding the water.

photo362.name: photo362.jpg
photo362.title: St. Canice's Cathedral
photo362.description: St. Canice's Cathedral and its iconic round tower in Kilkenny, Ireland. The round tower has been standing since the 9th century -- talk about uptime.

photo363.name: photo363.jpg
photo363.title: Kilkenny From Above
photo363.description: Aerial view from the round tower looking down over St. Canice's Cathedral rooftop and the surrounding Kilkenny neighborhood.

photo364.name: photo364.jpg
photo364.title: St. Mary's Cathedral
photo364.description: St. Mary's Cathedral towering over the town of Kilkenny, viewed from the round tower on a clear blue day.

photo365.name: photo365.jpg
photo365.title: Tower View Graveyard
photo365.description: Looking down from the round tower onto the old graveyard and cathedral grounds in Kilkenny. Heights and headstones -- bold combo for a Tuesday.

photo366.name: photo366.jpg
photo366.title: Kilkenny Main Street
photo366.description: The main street of Kilkenny on a sunny day, with a couple holding hands and a ghost sign for 'Dining Rooms' on the old building. Small town Ireland charm.

photo367.name: photo367.jpg
photo367.title: Kilkenny Side Street
photo367.description: A narrow pedestrian lane in Kilkenny buzzing with shoppers, pubs, and an Irish Ice Cream shop. The Daniel W. Bollard storefront has seen some centuries.

photo368.name: photo368.jpg
photo368.title: Kilkenny Castle Walk
photo368.description: A tree-lined path alongside the stone walls of Kilkenny Castle on a summer afternoon. Medieval fortress meets city park.

photo369.name: photo369.jpg
photo369.title: Glendalough Cemetery
photo369.description: Ancient Celtic cross headstones in the cemetery at Glendalough, nestled in a lush green valley in the Wicklow Mountains. Hauntingly beautiful.

photo37.name: photo37.jpg
photo37.title: Bern Minster Skyline
photo37.description: The soaring spire of the Bern Minster rising above the old town's autumn rooftops on a misty day.

photo370.name: photo370.jpg
photo370.title: Glendalough Lake
photo370.description: The upper lake at Glendalough, nestled between green mountains in the Wicklow hills. Ireland does moody water better than anyone.

photo371.name: photo371.jpg
photo371.title: Local Celebrity
photo371.description: This fluffy Irish sheep posed for me like it knew exactly what it was doing. Yellow ear tag and all.

photo372.name: photo372.jpg
photo372.title: Good Boy on Duty
photo372.description: Border collie living its best life on an Irish farm. Tongue out, zero concerns.

photo373.name: photo373.jpg
photo373.title: Head Scratches Acquired
photo373.description: The border collie found a human willing to provide ear scratches. Mission accomplished.

photo374.name: photo374.jpg
photo374.title: Sheep Closeup
photo374.description: This sheep looked directly into my soul. I blinked first.

photo375.name: photo375.jpg
photo375.title: Lady Justice, Dublin
photo375.description: The Lady Justice statue atop Dublin Castle, sword raised and scales balanced against a perfect blue sky.

photo376.name: photo376.jpg
photo376.title: Dublin Castle Record Tower
photo376.description: The medieval Record Tower at Dublin Castle, surrounded by construction cranes. Dublin's oldest new visitor attraction, apparently.

photo377.name: photo377.jpg
photo377.title: Chapel Royal Organ
photo377.description: The ornate pipe organ inside the Chapel Royal at Dublin Castle. Gothic vaulting and dark carved wood everywhere you look.

photo378.name: photo378.jpg
photo378.title: Gilded Arches
photo378.description: Gold leaf ceiling details inside Dublin Castle's state apartments. They really went all out with the budget on this hallway.

photo379.name: photo379.jpg
photo379.title: State Drawing Room
photo379.description: The crimson State Drawing Room at Dublin Castle, dripping with chandeliers and old portraits. My dorm room could never.

photo38.name: photo38.jpg
photo38.title: Zytglogge Clock
photo38.description: Bern's famous Zytglogge astronomical clock in all its gilded, painted, mechanical glory. The original smartwatch.

photo380.name: photo380.jpg
photo380.title: St Patrick's Cathedral
photo380.description: St Patrick's Cathedral rising above the park greenery on a sunny Dublin afternoon. People scattered on benches, soaking it in.

photo381.name: photo381.jpg
photo381.title: The Nave
photo381.description: Looking down the nave of St Patrick's Cathedral through a golden cross, heraldic banners hanging from the Gothic arches on both sides.

photo382.name: photo382.jpg
photo382.title: Banners and Vaults
photo382.description: The choir area of St Patrick's Cathedral, packed with colorful heraldic banners and stained glass. Over 800 years of history in one frame.

photo383.name: photo383.jpg
photo383.title: Howth Cliff Walk
photo383.description: The Baily Lighthouse perched at the edge of Howth Head, gorse blooming yellow all over the hillside. Worth every step of the cliff walk.

photo384.name: photo384.jpg
photo384.title: Baily Lighthouse View
photo384.description: Howth Head stretching out to the Baily Lighthouse with Dublin Bay and the Wicklow Mountains hazy in the distance.

photo385.name: photo385.jpg
photo385.title: Howth Peninsula
photo385.description: Golden gorse and green cliffs tumbling down to the Irish Sea, with the lighthouse standing guard on the point.

photo386.name: photo386.jpg
photo386.title: Gorse in Bloom
photo386.description: A wall of yellow gorse bushes against blue sky. Ireland in spring smells like coconut because of these things. Seriously.

photo387.name: photo387.jpg
photo387.title: Gorse Macro
photo387.description: Close-up of gorse flowers blazing in the sunlight. Tiny yellow petals doing their best impression of sunshine.

photo388.name: photo388.jpg
photo388.title: Baily Lighthouse Point
photo388.description: The green headland reaching out to the lighthouse with the open sea beyond. Not a bad spot for a Tuesday.

photo389.name: photo389.jpg
photo389.title: Which Way Now
photo389.description: A sticker-bombed trail signpost at the cliff's edge, pointing in three different directions over the Irish Sea. I chose the scenic one. They were all scenic.

photo39.name: photo39.jpg
photo39.title: Bern Minster Up Close
photo39.description: The intricate Gothic stonework of the Bern Minster tower framed by chestnut branches losing their autumn leaves.

photo390.name: photo390.jpg
photo390.title: Holy Seagull
photo390.description: A seagull perched on top of a Celtic cross like it owns the place. Honestly, it probably does.

photo391.name: photo391.jpg
photo391.title: Grafton Street at Dusk
photo391.description: Dublin's Grafton Street in the golden hour, the Gaiety Theatre sign glowing red. Starbucks on one side, donut shop on the other. Peak city.

photo392.name: photo392.jpg
photo392.title: The Photographer
photo392.description: Self-portrait in a Dublin shop, headphones around the neck, curly hair doing its thing. This is the guy behind the camera.

photo393.name: photo393.jpg
photo393.title: Tokyo Neighborhood Park
photo393.description: A quiet little park tucked between apartment buildings in Tokyo. Playground, trees, and not a single person around.

photo394.name: photo394.jpg
photo394.title: Tokyo After Dark
photo394.description: Tokyo's sprawling cityscape at night from above, highways cutting through the darkness like veins of light. Thirteen million people down there somewhere.

photo395.name: photo395.jpg
photo395.title: Karaoke Kan
photo395.description: Neon karaoke sign glowing in the Tokyo night. Did I go in? A gentleman never tells. (Yes I did.)

photo396.name: photo396.jpg
photo396.title: Apartment Grid
photo396.description: Rows of identical apartment doors lit by hallway lights at night. Japanese apartment buildings are architecturally therapeutic.

photo397.name: photo397.jpg
photo397.title: Osaka Castle Moat
photo397.description: The massive stone walls and moat of Osaka Castle, still holding strong after centuries. The green water adds to the vibe.

photo398.name: photo398.jpg
photo398.title: Castle Grounds Stroll
photo398.description: Walking the grounds of Osaka Castle on a hot day. The hat was not optional, it was survival gear.

photo399.name: photo399.jpg
photo399.title: Moat Boat Cruise
photo399.description: A golden-roofed boat gliding through the moat of Osaka Castle. Pretty sure the passengers had a better view than I did.

photo4.name: photo4.jpg
photo4.title: Nave of Vysehrad
photo4.description: The ornate nave of the Basilica of St. Peter and St. Paul, every inch painted floor to ceiling in gold and color.

photo40.name: photo40.jpg
photo40.title: Inside Bern Minster
photo40.description: Light streaming through the massive stained glass windows of the Bern Minster, filling the vaulted nave with color.

photo400.name: photo400.jpg
photo400.title: Castle Stone Walls
photo400.description: The towering stone ramparts of Osaka Castle, overgrown with ivy and capped with a brick building. Old meets older.

photo401.name: photo401.jpg
photo401.title: View from Osaka Castle
photo401.description: The Osaka skyline from the top of the castle, with the golden shachihoko fish ornament in the corner. Ancient fortress meets modern metropolis.

photo402.name: photo402.jpg
photo402.title: Osaka Panorama
photo402.description: Osaka sprawling to the mountains from the castle observation deck. The city just keeps going and going.

photo403.name: photo403.jpg
photo403.title: Osaka Castle
photo403.description: The iconic Osaka Castle in full glory, white walls and gold trim gleaming under a clear blue sky. Toyotomi Hideyoshi knew how to build a flex.

photo404.name: photo404.jpg
photo404.title: Castle Walls and Moat
photo404.description: Stone walls of Osaka Castle looming over the outer moat, a tour boat drifting below with modern skyscrapers behind.

photo405.name: photo405.jpg
photo405.title: Myaku-Myaku
photo405.description: The delightfully unhinged Expo 2025 mascot Myaku-Myaku, all red blobs and eyeballs, greeting visitors. Japan really said 'what if a mascot had too many eyes.'

photo406.name: photo406.jpg
photo406.title: Expo Timber Frame
photo406.description: Light pouring through the massive wooden lattice structure at Expo 2025 Osaka. The engineering alone is worth the trip.

photo407.name: photo407.jpg
photo407.title: Expo 2025 Overview
photo407.description: The Expo 2025 Osaka grounds from above at golden hour, circular pavilions and green rooftops stretching toward the harbor.

photo408.name: photo408.jpg
photo408.title: Expo Sunset
photo408.description: Sunset over the Expo 2025 waterfront, silhouettes of visitors lined along the walkway. One of those moments you just stop and watch.

photo409.name: photo409.jpg
photo409.title: Napa Valley in Osaka
photo409.description: Someone wearing a Napa Valley Vineyards cap at an Expo in Japan. The most American thing at the world's fair.

photo41.name: photo41.jpg
photo41.title: Bern's Famous Resident
photo41.description: A brown bear ambling through the Barengraben bear park in Bern. The city's mascot doing mascot things.

photo410.name: photo410.jpg
photo410.title: Kiyomizu-dera Flag
photo410.description: The Japanese flag flying in front of Kiyomizu-dera's vermillion gate, with the three-story pagoda peeking behind. Red on red on red.

photo411.name: photo411.jpg
photo411.title: Kiyomizu-dera Approach
photo411.description: Climbing the steps toward Kiyomizu-dera's main gate and pagoda in Kyoto. The crowds came for a reason.

photo412.name: photo412.jpg
photo412.title: Hat at the Temple
photo412.description: Bucket hat POV entering Kiyomizu-dera. When you're more focused on not getting heatstroke than the 1,200-year-old temple.

photo413.name: photo413.jpg
photo413.title: Kiyomizu Pagoda
photo413.description: The three-story pagoda at Kiyomizu-dera rising against the Kyoto sky. Clean lines and centuries of history.

photo414.name: photo414.jpg
photo414.title: Kiyomizu Stage Below
photo414.description: Looking across at one of Kiyomizu-dera's halls nestled into the hillside, tourists packed onto the viewing platform surrounded by green maples.

photo415.name: photo415.jpg
photo415.title: Temple Crowd
photo415.description: Tourists gathering under the colorful eaves of a Kiyomizu-dera hall. The painted bracket details deserve a closer look than most people give them.

photo416.name: photo416.jpg
photo416.title: Kiyomizu Main Hall
photo416.description: The famous wooden stage of Kiyomizu-dera's main hall, perched on massive pillars above a sea of green trees. Built without a single nail.

photo417.name: photo417.jpg
photo417.title: Pagoda Through Leaves
photo417.description: Kiyomizu-dera's pagoda framed through branches, the city of Kyoto sprawling out below in the haze. A postcard that earned itself.

photo418.name: photo418.jpg
photo418.title: Cicada on Bark
photo418.description: A cicada clinging to a tree trunk in the temple grounds. The soundtrack of every Japanese summer.

photo419.name: photo419.jpg
photo419.title: Stone Lantern Window
photo419.description: A small stone sitting inside the window of a Japanese stone lantern. Someone placed it there on purpose. I respect the commitment.

photo42.name: photo42.jpg
photo42.title: Bern in the Fog
photo42.description: The Bern Minster dissolving into thick fog above a sea of rooftops. The whole city looks like it's buffering.

photo420.name: photo420.jpg
photo420.title: Shade Break
photo420.description: Taking a breather in the shade somewhere in Kyoto's temple grounds. The hat is doing heavy lifting.

photo421.name: photo421.jpg
photo421.title: Temple Garden Path
photo421.description: A stone lantern and kanji-carved monument marking the entrance to a peaceful Kyoto temple garden. Zero tourists. Just me and ancient stone.

photo422.name: photo422.jpg
photo422.title: Kyoto Shop Lantern
photo422.description: A traditional Japanese lantern sign for a dried goods shop in Kyoto, established in the Meiji era. Some shops here are older than my entire country.

photo423.name: photo423.jpg
photo423.title: Yasaka Pagoda Street
photo423.description: The five-story Yasaka Pagoda towering over the narrow streets of Higashiyama, sake shop signs in the foreground. This is the Kyoto postcard shot.

photo424.name: photo424.jpg
photo424.title: Fushimi Inari Torii
photo424.description: Walking through the famous thousand torii gates at Fushimi Inari, each one inscribed with the name of its donor. The orange glow is surreal.

photo425.name: photo425.jpg
photo425.title: Fushimi Inari Shrine
photo425.description: Sunlight catching a torii gate at a small sub-shrine on the Fushimi Inari mountain trail. The forest gets quieter the higher you climb.

photo426.name: photo426.jpg
photo426.title: Kyoto from Inari
photo426.description: The Kyoto cityscape from the top of Mount Inari, hazy and endless beneath the clouds. Worth the 233-meter climb in summer heat.

photo427.name: photo427.jpg
photo427.title: Endless Torii
photo427.description: Another tunnel of vermillion torii gates climbing up Mount Inari. Every time you think it's the last one, there's another hundred.

photo428.name: photo428.jpg
photo428.title: Please Do Not Stop
photo428.description: Standing at the Inari station turnstile under a sign that says 'Please do not stop.' Ironic, since I've been walking for hours.

photo429.name: photo429.jpg
photo429.title: Ticket Window
photo429.description: Buying a train ticket at the JR station window in Kyoto. The Coca-Cola shirt is doing international diplomacy.

photo43.name: photo43.jpg
photo43.title: Last Rose of Autumn
photo43.description: A deep red rose holding on to its final bloom in a Bern garden, petals edged with the first hints of frost.

photo430.name: photo430.jpg
photo430.title: Kinkaku-ji Reflection
photo430.description: The Golden Pavilion reflected perfectly in the mirror pond, surrounded by meticulously shaped pines. Even on a cloudy day, Kinkaku-ji glows.

photo431.name: photo431.jpg
photo431.title: Golden Pavilion Close
photo431.description: Kinkaku-ji up close, all three stories shimmering in gold leaf with the phoenix ornament on top. The most photogenic building in Japan, and it knows it.

photo432.name: photo432.jpg
photo432.title: Kinkaku-ji Detail
photo432.description: The upper floors of Kinkaku-ji in gold against an overcast sky, a bonsai-perfect pine framing the bottom. Every angle is a painting.

photo433.name: photo433.jpg
photo433.title: Zen Rock Garden
photo433.description: A single rock island in a sea of raked white gravel. This is either deeply profound or a really high-effort cat litter box. Probably Ryoan-ji.

photo434.name: photo434.jpg
photo434.title: Ninnaji Temple
photo434.description: The grand wooden hall of Ninna-ji temple in Kyoto, dark timber and ornate metalwork under a swooping tile roof. Serenely empty.

photo435.name: photo435.jpg
photo435.title: Tenryu-ji Garden
photo435.description: The pond garden at Tenryu-ji temple in Arashiyama, rocks and water and every shade of green the forest can offer. Peak zen.

photo436.name: photo436.jpg
photo436.title: Temple Rooftop Garden
photo436.description: Traditional tile rooftops peeking through perfectly shaped hedges and towering maples at a Kyoto temple. The gardeners here don't mess around.

photo437.name: photo437.jpg
photo437.title: Kyoto Cemetery
photo437.description: A hillside cemetery in Kyoto with rows of stone graves and a distant pagoda, framed by bamboo and mountain forest. Peaceful in a way that makes you whisper.

photo438.name: photo438.jpg
photo438.title: Bamboo Grove Scrolling
photo438.description: Checking the phone in the Arashiyama Bamboo Grove. Surrounded by one of the most beautiful places on earth, and still looking at a screen. We are all this person.

photo439.name: photo439.jpg
photo439.title: Lotus Pond
photo439.description: A pond completely covered in lotus leaves with a few pink blooms poking through, mountains rising behind. Kyoto does green like nowhere else.

photo44.name: photo44.jpg
photo44.title: Bern Rose Garden
photo44.description: The immaculate Rosengarten in Bern, green lawns bordered by rose bushes and trellised vines, a quiet escape above the old town.

photo440.name: photo440.jpg
photo440.title: Nara Mom and Baby
photo440.description: A fawn nuzzling up to its mother in Nara Park. Even deer have better family photos than me.

photo441.name: photo441.jpg
photo441.title: Bambi Close-Up
photo441.description: This baby deer in Nara got way too comfortable with the camera. Those eyelashes though.

photo442.name: photo442.jpg
photo442.title: Unbothered Nara Deer
photo442.description: She looked right through me like I owed her a shika senbei and came empty-handed.

photo443.name: photo443.jpg
photo443.title: Spotted in Nara
photo443.description: A spotted fawn pausing by a wooden temple structure. Posing like she knows she's the main character.

photo444.name: photo444.jpg
photo444.title: Deer Eye Macro
photo444.description: Extreme close-up of a Nara deer's eye. You can see the whole park reflected in there.

photo445.name: photo445.jpg
photo445.title: Sapporo Star
photo445.description: The iconic Sapporo beer star glowing against the night sky. A beacon of hope after a long day of hiking.

photo446.name: photo446.jpg
photo446.title: Parking Lot Portrait
photo446.description: Backwards cap, glasses, parking lot. Every study abroad trip needs at least one candid that looks like an album cover.

photo447.name: photo447.jpg
photo447.title: Dashboard Guardian
photo447.description: A Pokemon plushie riding shotgun on a car dashboard in Japan. Someone's got their priorities straight.

photo448.name: photo448.jpg
photo448.title: Sapporo After Dark
photo448.description: The Sapporo skyline glittering at night, neon signs cutting through the haze.

photo449.name: photo449.jpg
photo449.title: Coke Zero Still Life
photo449.description: A Coca-Cola Zero Sugar can sitting on a rain-speckled surface. Staying hydrated is important, even in Japan.

photo45.name: photo45.jpg
photo45.title: Einstein on a Bench
photo45.description: A bronze Albert Einstein sitting casually on a park bench in Bern, looking like he's about to explain relativity to whoever sits next to him.

photo450.name: photo450.jpg
photo450.title: Fluorescent Bokeh
photo450.description: A fluorescent light fixture with dreamy bokeh orbs in the background. Sometimes you just photograph ceiling lights at 2 AM.

photo451.name: photo451.jpg
photo451.title: Rain Over Mountains
photo451.description: Storm clouds dropping rain across layers of blue-green mountains in Hokkaido. Nature doing its watercolor thing.

photo452.name: photo452.jpg
photo452.title: Hokkaido Hilltop View
photo452.description: Lush green valley stretching to distant mountains under dramatic summer clouds. Worth every mosquito bite.

photo453.name: photo453.jpg
photo453.title: Lake Shikotsu Calm
photo453.description: A perfectly still Hokkaido lake reflecting mountains and moody clouds. Not a single ripple.

photo454.name: photo454.jpg
photo454.title: Lake Through Leaves
photo454.description: A lake framed by green branches, mountains in the distance under overcast skies. Nature's window.

photo455.name: photo455.jpg
photo455.title: Emerald Forest Path
photo455.description: A trail disappearing into dense green Hokkaido forest. Every Miyazaki film started somewhere like this.

photo456.name: photo456.jpg
photo456.title: Trail Pondering
photo456.description: A friend standing on a forest trail, hand on chin, surrounded by wildflowers and endless green.

photo457.name: photo457.jpg
photo457.title: Wild Deer Encounter
photo457.description: Two spotted deer blocking the hiking trail in Hokkaido. They were here first and they know it.

photo458.name: photo458.jpg
photo458.title: Horoka Station Ruins
photo458.description: The abandoned Horoka train station, tracks swallowed by moss and grass. Nature always wins eventually.

photo459.name: photo459.jpg
photo459.title: Hokkaido Green Peak
photo459.description: A forested mountain framed by tall trees, every shade of green imaginable.

photo46.name: photo46.jpg
photo46.title: Above the Clouds
photo46.description: Golden sunrise breaking over a sea of clouds somewhere in the Swiss hills. Alarm clock said 5 AM. Zero regrets.

photo460.name: photo460.jpg
photo460.title: Mikuni Pass Bridge
photo460.description: A sweeping red bridge arcing through a sea of green forest in Hokkaido's mountains. Engineering meeting wilderness.

photo461.name: photo461.jpg
photo461.title: Mikuni Bridge Closer
photo461.description: A closer look at the red Mikuni Pass bridge with a lone car crossing. Tiny humans, big world.

photo462.name: photo462.jpg
photo462.title: Ropeway Through Clouds
photo462.description: Looking down from a cable car as clouds weave between Hokkaido's volcanic cliffs. Don't look down. Too late.
