photo463.name: photo463.jpg
photo463.title: Above the Cloud Line
photo463.description: Cable car cables stretching across misty mountain peaks. Somewhere between the clouds and a mild panic attack.

photo464.name: photo464.jpg
photo464.title: Swallowtail Caterpillar
photo464.description: A vivid green-and-black striped caterpillar munching on white wildflowers. Future butterfly, current unit.

photo465.name: photo465.jpg
photo465.title: Foggy Photographer
photo465.description: A friend with a camera emerging from thick mountain fog. Dedicated to the craft even when visibility is approximately zero.

photo466.name: photo466.jpg
photo466.title: Tree-Lined Promenade
photo466.description: Visitors strolling beneath a canopy of gnarled trees in a Hokkaido park. Natural air conditioning.

photo467.name: photo467.jpg
photo467.title: Chestnut Branches
photo467.description: Small round fruits hanging among green leaves. Just some tree doing tree things.

photo468.name: photo468.jpg
photo468.title: Farm Tomita Overview
photo468.description: Rows of lavender and colorful flowers at Farm Tomita in Furano, Hokkaido.

photo469.name: photo469.jpg
photo469.title: Orange Zinnias
photo469.description: Bright orange zinnias in full bloom. The kind of color your phone screen can't do justice.

photo47.name: photo47.jpg
photo47.title: Rhine River Boats
photo47.description: The Rhine flowing past Eglisau, covered boats lining the banks and vineyards climbing the far hillside in autumn gold.

photo470.name: photo470.jpg
photo470.title: Furano Flower Stripes
photo470.description: Rows of yellow, red, and pink flowers stretching across a farm with a wooden barn behind them. Hokkaido's answer to a screensaver.

photo471.name: photo471.jpg
photo471.title: Color Field Theory
photo471.description: Bold bands of yellow and red flowers rolling across the Furano countryside under moody skies.

photo472.name: photo472.jpg
photo472.title: Rainbow Flower Rows
photo472.description: Every color imaginable planted in precise rows at a Furano flower farm, mountains and town in the background.

photo473.name: photo473.jpg
photo473.title: Lavender Fields Forever
photo473.description: Rows of lavender bushes stretching toward distant hills in Nakafurano, Hokkaido. Smelled even better than it looked.

photo474.name: photo474.jpg
photo474.title: Farm Tomita Banner
photo474.description: The purple Farm Tomita banner proudly displayed: since 1958, Nakafurano, Hokkaido.

photo475.name: photo475.jpg
photo475.title: Lavender Scooter
photo475.description: A purple scooter parked near Farm Tomita. Even the transportation is on brand.

photo476.name: photo476.jpg
photo476.title: Furano Valley Overlook
photo476.description: Lavender fields cascading downhill toward birch trees, farmland, and a small town in the valley below.

photo477.name: photo477.jpg
photo477.title: Lavender Hill Curves
photo477.description: Soft purple lavender bushes curving along a winding path, bright green grass in between.

photo478.name: photo478.jpg
photo478.title: Celosia and Barn
photo478.description: Fiery red and yellow celosia flowers blazing in front of a white barn at Farm Tomita. Peak Hokkaido summer.

photo479.name: photo479.jpg
photo479.title: Flower Field Gazing
photo479.description: Back of a friend's head looking out over purple and pink flower fields. Keith Haring shirt, lavender vibes.

photo48.name: photo48.jpg
photo48.title: Quiet Chapel Interior
photo48.description: The simple, whitewashed interior of a small Swiss chapel with faded medieval frescoes peeking through the walls.

photo480.name: photo480.jpg
photo480.title: Seedlings and Barn
photo480.description: Young snapdragon plants growing in dark Hokkaido soil with a farm building soft in the background.

photo481.name: photo481.jpg
photo481.title: Celosia Up Close
photo481.description: Deep magenta celosia plumes crowding together. Fuzzy, vibrant, and weirdly satisfying to look at.

photo482.name: photo482.jpg
photo482.title: Yellow Celosia Sea
photo482.description: An ocean of golden celosia with red ones behind, visitors wandering the edges of Farm Tomita.

photo483.name: photo483.jpg
photo483.title: Fire and Gold
photo483.description: Red and yellow celosia flowers layered with lavender behind them, a greenhouse catching the light.

photo484.name: photo484.jpg
photo484.title: Flower Rainbow Panorama
photo484.description: Bands of red, yellow, pink, and purple celosia sweeping across a Furano hillside under overcast skies.

photo485.name: photo485.jpg
photo485.title: Victory in Furano
photo485.description: Fist pump energy in front of an evergreen tree. He survived the flower farms. Barely.

photo486.name: photo486.jpg
photo486.title: Hillside in Bloom
photo486.description: A ski slope transformed into a summer flower quilt at a Furano resort. Red, orange, white, and pink rows ascending the hill.

photo487.name: photo487.jpg
photo487.title: Hay Bale King
photo487.description: A friend sitting on a hay bale with the entire Furano valley behind him. Coke shirt, panoramic views, peak content.

photo488.name: photo488.jpg
photo488.title: Furano Valley Panorama
photo488.description: Sweeping view over the Furano valley from a hilltop with lawn chairs below. This is where you sit and question why you ever leave.

photo489.name: photo489.jpg
photo489.title: Yodobashi Camera Night
photo489.description: The neon glow of Yodobashi Camera electronics store lighting up a Tokyo street at night. Wallet in danger.

photo49.name: photo49.jpg
photo49.title: Memorial Wall
photo49.description: Stone memorial plaques line a church wall, framed by autumn ivy and red roses. History and beauty aging together.

photo490.name: photo490.jpg
photo490.title: Don't Walk
photo490.description: A Japanese pedestrian signal glowing red. Even the crosswalk figures in Tokyo have better posture than me.

photo491.name: photo491.jpg
photo491.title: Empty Tunnel Corridor
photo491.description: An eerily empty underground corridor in a Japanese station. Liminal space energy at its finest.

photo492.name: photo492.jpg
photo492.title: Metro Station Glow
photo492.description: Yellow and blue light reflecting off the polished floors of an empty Tokyo metro station. Late night vibes.

photo493.name: photo493.jpg
photo493.title: Imperial Palace Bridge
photo493.description: The Nijubashi Bridge at Tokyo's Imperial Palace, stone arches over the moat with the watchtower rising above the trees.

photo494.name: photo494.jpg
photo494.title: Seimon Ishibashi Wide
photo494.description: A wider view of the Imperial Palace's stone bridge and moat on an overcast day. History just sitting there in the middle of Tokyo.

photo495.name: photo495.jpg
photo495.title: Shinjuku From Above
photo495.description: The Tokyo skyline from the Metropolitan Government Building observation deck. NTT Docomo Tower poking through the haze.

photo496.name: photo496.jpg
photo496.title: Concrete Jungle Sprawl
photo496.description: Shinjuku's skyscrapers from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building. The city just goes and goes and never stops.

photo497.name: photo497.jpg
photo497.title: Bondarenko Cutout
photo497.description: A high jumper cutout display hanging from a ceiling, Ukrainian TDK athlete frozen mid-leap. Found in a Tokyo station.

photo498.name: photo498.jpg
photo498.title: Tokyo Back Alley
photo498.description: A quiet Tokyo side street packed with izakayas, sushi joints, and a Thai restaurant. Decision paralysis in physical form.

photo499.name: photo499.jpg
photo499.title: Ueno Lotus Skyline
photo499.description: Lotus leaves blanketing Shinobazu Pond with Tokyo high-rises looming behind. Nature holds its ground.

photo500.name: photo500.jpg
photo500.title: Ducks on Capsized Boats
photo500.description: Ducks chilling on overturned rowboats in a Tokyo park pond. Real estate is real estate.

photo501.name: photo501.jpg
photo501.title: Shinobazu Pond Lotus
photo501.description: A carpet of lotus pads stretching across Shinobazu Pond at Ueno, city skyline peeking over the greenery.

photo502.name: photo502.jpg
photo502.title: Bentendo Festival Lanterns
photo502.description: Rows of paper lanterns framing the red Bentendo temple at Ueno's Shinobazu Pond during a festival.

photo503.name: photo503.jpg
photo503.title: Bentendo Purification
photo503.description: A stone purification basin flanked by lanterns at Bentendo temple, lotus pond sprawling behind it.

photo504.name: photo504.jpg
photo504.title: Candy Apple Attack
photo504.description: Extreme close-up of a friend going in on a Japanese candy apple. Commitment to the snack is unquestionable.

photo505.name: photo505.jpg
photo505.title: Bentendo at Dusk
photo505.description: The Bentendo temple glowing golden against the evening sky, lotus pods dotting the pond in front. Magic hour earned.

photo506.name: photo506.jpg
photo506.title: Wind Chime Wishes
photo506.description: Glass furin wind chimes hanging from a bamboo frame with handwritten paper strips. Summer sounds of Tokyo.

photo507.name: photo507.jpg
photo507.title: Festival Food Hustle
photo507.description: Street food vendors working the fryers at a night festival near Ueno. The smell alone could make you line up.

photo508.name: photo508.jpg
photo508.title: Ueno Blue Hour
photo508.description: The streets near Ueno Park at dusk, deep blue sky contrasting with warm building lights.

photo509.name: photo509.jpg
photo509.title: Ameyoko Night Buzz
photo509.description: The neon entrance to Ameyoko market near Ueno at night, traffic and crowds filling the street. Organized chaos.

photo51.name: photo51.jpg
photo51.title: Vineyard and River
photo51.description: Autumn grapevines in the foreground, the Rhine curving gently through forested hills behind. This is what wine country looks like before the wine.

photo510.name: photo510.jpg
photo510.title: Ueno After Dark
photo510.description: Yodobashi Camera and the neon jungle of Ueno at night. The city never really sleeps, it just switches to a different color palette.

photo511.name: photo511.jpg
photo511.title: Shibuya Scramble
photo511.description: Standing in the middle of the world's most famous crosswalk surrounded by a thousand strangers. Somehow it feels like the main character moment I never asked for.

photo512.name: photo512.jpg
photo512.title: Disney+ Meets Yakult
photo512.description: Mickey eating corn next to a Yakult ad. Peak Japan advertising synergy that I did not expect at midnight.

photo513.name: photo513.jpg
photo513.title: Shibuya Street Level
photo513.description: The crowd spills out of the crossing and into the surrounding streets. A screen behind them plays footage of Mt. Fuji, the one thing you can't see from here.

photo514.name: photo514.jpg
photo514.title: Sticker Pole Shibuya
photo514.description: Two heads, a sticker-bombed pole, and the blurry bokeh of Shibuya behind them. Sometimes the best shots are the accidental ones.

photo515.name: photo515.jpg
photo515.title: Rural Japan Road
photo515.description: A quiet mountain road winding through a Japanese village. No traffic, no noise, just power lines and green hills.

photo516.name: photo516.jpg
photo516.title: River Through Town
photo516.description: A gentle river flowing past traditional Japanese houses with mountains hiding behind the clouds. This is the Japan the anime promised me.

photo517.name: photo517.jpg
photo517.title: Ryokan Window View
photo517.description: The view from the guesthouse window. A folding stool, some greenery, and the kind of peace you can't find on a screen.

photo518.name: photo518.jpg
photo518.title: Rice Paddy Greens
photo518.description: Bright green rice paddies stretching up to the doorsteps of mountain village houses. The grass really is greener on this side.

photo519.name: photo519.jpg
photo519.title: Night Road, 30 kph
photo519.description: A lonely rural Japanese road lit only by a warehouse's glowing windows. The 30 kph speed limit sign seems optimistic given zero cars exist here.

photo52.name: photo52.jpg
photo52.title: Golden Vineyard Terraces
photo52.description: Terraced vineyards blazing yellow along the Rhine, a small village and viaduct nestled in the valley below.

photo520.name: photo520.jpg
photo520.title: Midnight Mirror
photo520.description: A convex traffic mirror reflecting an empty Japanese village at night. The whole town fits in one circle.

photo521.name: photo521.jpg
photo521.title: Mountain Village Overcast
photo521.description: Storm clouds rolling over a quiet Japanese neighborhood with a stream running through. The kind of sky that says bring an umbrella or regret it.

photo522.name: photo522.jpg
photo522.title: Chureito Pagoda
photo522.description: The iconic Chureito Pagoda overlooking the Fujiyoshida cityscape. Fuji was supposed to be right behind it but decided to play hide and seek with the clouds.

photo523.name: photo523.jpg
photo523.title: Chureito From Above
photo523.description: The five-story pagoda framed by pine trees from the upper viewpoint. Tourists pack the observation deck below, all pointing cameras at the same spot.

photo524.name: photo524.jpg
photo524.title: Japanese Suburbia
photo524.description: Matching modern apartments on a quiet cul-de-sac near the mountains. Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V housing development but make it aesthetic.

photo525.name: photo525.jpg
photo525.title: Tsurugaoka Hachimangu View
photo525.description: Looking down the central approach of Tsurugaoka Hachimangu shrine in Kamakura. The massive red torii frames the avenue stretching to the sea.

photo526.name: photo526.jpg
photo526.title: Ema Prayer Boards
photo526.description: Rows and rows of wooden ema wish plaques hanging at the shrine. Hundreds of hopes and dreams dangling in the summer breeze.

photo527.name: photo527.jpg
photo527.title: Koi Pond Life
photo527.description: Koi fish gliding through murky green water at a shrine pond. Living their best life, completely unbothered by tourists with cameras.

photo528.name: photo528.jpg
photo528.title: Duck on a Rock
photo528.description: A duck standing on a rock by the water, contemplating existence. Honestly, same.

photo529.name: photo529.jpg
photo529.title: Carp Convention
photo529.description: About fifteen massive carp fighting for the same square foot of water. This is what rush hour looks like if you're a fish.

photo53.name: photo53.jpg
photo53.title: Village and Viaduct
photo53.description: A misty view of a Swiss village with its church steeple and a massive railway viaduct spanning the background.

photo530.name: photo530.jpg
photo530.title: Temple Side Garden
photo530.description: Potted plants lined up outside a traditional wooden temple in Kamakura. Someone here has a serious gardening habit.

photo531.name: photo531.jpg
photo531.title: Jizo and the Thousands
photo531.description: A large Jizo statue surrounded by hundreds of tiny stone figures at Hase-dera. The scale of devotion here is quietly overwhelming.

photo532.name: photo532.jpg
photo532.title: Jizo Close-Up
photo532.description: Rows of small smiling Jizo statues standing shoulder to shoulder. Each one slightly different, all of them absolutely vibing.

photo533.name: photo533.jpg
photo533.title: Hase-dera Temple Grounds
photo533.description: The main hall and stone lanterns of Hase-dera temple in Kamakura at dusk. Visitors strolling through as the day winds down.

photo534.name: photo534.jpg
photo534.title: Shonan Monorail
photo534.description: A suspended monorail gliding overhead through a tangle of power lines. Japan casually having trains that hang from the sky like it's no big deal.

photo535.name: photo535.jpg
photo535.title: Coastal City Sunset
photo535.description: The sun setting over a Japanese coastal town, rooftops stretching to the hazy horizon. Golden hour doing its thing.

photo536.name: photo536.jpg
photo536.title: Enoshima Sea Candle
photo536.description: The Enoshima Sea Candle observation tower peeking above the treeline with palm trees in the foreground. Tropical vibes in Kanagawa.

photo537.name: photo537.jpg
photo537.title: Enoshima Harbor View
photo537.description: Looking down from Enoshima island over the harbor and marina at twilight. Sailboat masts catching the last light of the day.

photo538.name: photo538.jpg
photo538.title: Pacific Sunset
photo538.description: The open Pacific stretching out from Enoshima's coastline at sunset. Pastel clouds and still water making this look like a painting.

photo539.name: photo539.jpg
photo539.title: Enoshima Bridge at Dusk
photo539.description: The bridge connecting Enoshima island to the mainland with pink clouds reflected in the water. Traffic lights creating a river of red and white.

photo54.name: photo54.jpg
photo54.title: Half-Timbered Classic
photo54.description: A picture-perfect red-and-white half-timbered house with green shutters, lit by an old street lamp. Switzerland really said 'copy-paste charm.'

photo540.name: photo540.jpg
photo540.title: Garden Lanterns From Above
photo540.description: A traditional Japanese garden viewed from the Enoshima tower at night. Paper lanterns lining the pathways like fireflies that forgot how to fly.

photo541.name: photo541.jpg
photo541.title: Purple Hour
photo541.description: The sky over the coast melting into lavender and pink as night falls. The kind of sunset that makes you forget you need to catch the last train.

photo542.name: photo542.jpg
photo542.title: Enoshima After Dark
photo542.description: The causeway and harbor seen from the tower as city lights begin to twinkle. That one bright green dot in the sky is either a drone or a very ambitious firefly.

photo543.name: photo543.jpg
photo543.title: Harbor Night Zoom
photo543.description: A closer look at the coastal city lights reflecting off the harbor water. Every window is a tiny story playing out at once.

photo544.name: photo544.jpg
photo544.title: Bridge Light Trail
photo544.description: The Enoshima bridge lit up at night, red taillights streaming toward the mainland. Everyone heading home from the island at the same time.

photo545.name: photo545.jpg
photo545.title: Enoshima Causeway Close
photo545.description: Zoomed in on the bridge with cars backed up bumper to bumper. Island life is great until you have to leave and so does everyone else.

photo546.name: photo546.jpg
photo546.title: Sea Candle at Night
photo546.description: The Enoshima Sea Candle tower lit up in electric blue and teal against the black sky. Looks like something out of a sci-fi movie.

photo547.name: photo547.jpg
photo547.title: Neon Pavilion
photo547.description: A Chinese-style pavilion bathed in red and purple light on Enoshima. The night illumination event turning a shrine garden into a cyberpunk scene.

photo548.name: photo548.jpg
photo548.title: Geometric Lanterns
photo548.description: Handcrafted paper lanterns with geometric patterns hanging in the darkness. Each one a little dodecahedron of light.

photo549.name: photo549.jpg
photo549.title: Lotus Lantern Detail
photo549.description: Close-up of a single dodecahedral lantern with a lotus flower motif. The craftsmanship on these is genuinely incredible.

photo55.name: photo55.jpg
photo55.title: Kandersteg Stream
photo55.description: A mountain stream rushing through the village of Kandersteg, massive cliff faces towering behind the wooden chalets.

photo550.name: photo550.jpg
photo550.title: Shrine in Red
photo550.description: A Shinto shrine building lit in deep crimson with shimenawa rope and paper streamers. The ornate woodwork carvings really pop under the dramatic lighting.

photo551.name: photo551.jpg
photo551.title: Enoshima Shrine Gate
photo551.description: The main gate of Enoshima Shrine illuminated in green and white with projections washing over it. A banner marks the Year of the Snake.

photo552.name: photo552.jpg
photo552.title: Night Market Buzz
photo552.description: The narrow shopping street leading up to Enoshima Shrine packed with people at night. Street food vendors and souvenir shops keeping the energy alive.

photo553.name: photo553.jpg
photo553.title: Bridge Walk Home
photo553.description: Walking across the Enoshima bridge at night with city lights reflecting in the dark water. The quiet side of the causeway after the crowds thin out.

photo554.name: photo554.jpg
photo554.title: Late Night Yokohama
photo554.description: A quiet Yokohama side street with izakaya signs glowing in the dark. The kind of alley where you find the best food at 11 PM.

photo555.name: photo555.jpg
photo555.title: The Backrooms (Japan)
photo555.description: A fluorescent-lit apartment corridor that looks like it leads to another dimension. If you see this hallway in a dream, do not enter.

photo556.name: photo556.jpg
photo556.title: Liminal Hallway Pt. 2
photo556.description: Another angle of the eerily quiet apartment corridor with green panels and a single red fire extinguisher. This is where horror movies begin.

photo557.name: photo557.jpg
photo557.title: Vending Machine Glow
photo557.description: A quiet residential intersection at night with a lone vending machine being the brightest thing on the block. Japan's real 24/7 convenience.

photo558.name: photo558.jpg
photo558.title: Zigzag Stairs
photo558.description: External zigzag stairs on an apartment building lit from above at night. Brutalist geometry that accidentally became art.

photo559.name: photo559.jpg
photo559.title: Yokohama Midnight
photo559.description: An empty Yokohama street at midnight with a Times parking lot sign and distant tower lights. The city sleeps but the parking meters don't.

photo56.name: photo56.jpg
photo56.title: Church Below the Peak
photo56.description: A small church with a golden spire standing before a snow-capped peak in the Bernese Oberland. Postcard material, no filter needed.

photo560.name: photo560.jpg
photo560.title: River Reflections
photo560.description: A canal at night with red lights reflecting off the dark water, framed by trees. The kind of moody shot that makes you feel like a film protagonist.

photo561.name: photo561.jpg
photo561.title: Last Walk Home
photo561.description: A residential intersection in Yokohama after midnight, street signs and a red traffic light the only company. The final frame of a long day.

photo57.name: photo57.jpg
photo57.title: Alpine Peak Through Pines
photo57.description: A snow-dusted Alpine peak framed by tall evergreens, wispy clouds streaking overhead.

photo58.name: photo58.jpg
photo58.title: The Summit
photo58.description: A dramatic rocky peak rising above the treeline, looking like it was drawn by someone who really likes triangles.

photo59.name: photo59.jpg
photo59.title: Oeschinensee Fire Pit
photo59.description: A campfire cooking tripod by the turquoise waters of Oeschinensee, mountains reflected in the impossibly blue surface.

photo6.name: photo6.jpg
photo6.title: Prague Castle at Night
photo6.description: Prague Castle and St. Vitus Cathedral lit up across the Vltava at blue hour. The kind of view that makes you stop and just stand there for a while.

photo61.name: photo61.jpg
photo61.title: Mirror Lake
photo61.description: The sun reflecting off Oeschinensee like a mirror, a single boat drifting in the center. This is the desktop wallpaper I was looking for.

photo62.name: photo62.jpg
photo62.title: Alpine Trail
photo62.description: A narrow mountain trail winding through pines above Oeschinensee, sunlight filtering through the trees.

photo64.name: photo64.jpg
photo64.title: Turquoise Shoreline
photo64.description: A weathered boulder perched on the edge of Oeschinensee's impossibly turquoise water. Switzerland is just showing off at this point.

photo65.name: photo65.jpg
photo65.title: Light Through the Cliff
photo65.description: Golden afternoon light streaming past a rock overhang high above the valley, pine trees silhouetted against the misty Alps.

photo66.name: photo66.jpg
photo66.title: Alpine Golden Hour
photo66.description: The Bernese Alps bathed in golden sunset light, snow-capped peaks and warm rock faces against swirling contrails in the sky.

photo67.name: photo67.jpg
photo67.title: Warm Glow
photo67.description: Arched windows and a wooden door lit by warm golden light in the evening. Cozy vibes, zero context needed.

photo68.name: photo68.jpg
photo68.title: Autumn in Winterthur
photo68.description: A brilliant yellow tree standing out against an overcast sky in a Swiss neighborhood. Autumn doing the absolute most.

photo69.name: photo69.jpg
photo69.title: Red Hourglass
photo69.description: A red hourglass-shaped sculpture on a building entrance, autumn bushes doing their thing nearby. Art is everywhere if you look.

photo7.name: photo7.jpg
photo7.title: Pavilion in the Park
photo7.description: A neoclassical pavilion nestled among autumn trees in a European park. Looks like it has opinions about architecture.

photo70.name: photo70.jpg
photo70.title: Natural History Museum, London
photo70.description: The grand Hintze Hall of London's Natural History Museum, cathedral-like arches and a blue whale skeleton overhead. They really built a church for dinosaurs.

photo71.name: photo71.jpg
photo71.title: Whale of a Time
photo71.description: Blue whale model and massive skeletons hanging from the ceiling at the Natural History Museum in London. The elephant below looks unimpressed.

photo72.name: photo72.jpg
photo72.title: Victoria Memorial
photo72.description: The golden Winged Victory gleaming above the crowds outside Buckingham Palace on a classic grey London day.

photo73.name: photo73.jpg
photo73.title: Buckingham Palace
photo73.description: Thousands of tourists and one guy who definitely lives there. The flag's up, so someone's home.

photo75.name: photo75.jpg
photo75.title: Westminster Abbey
photo75.description: Westminster Abbey's twin towers rising into an overcast sky, with a black cab completing the London starter pack.

photo76.name: photo76.jpg
photo76.title: Methodist Central Hall
photo76.description: The grand dome of Methodist Central Hall Westminster, flanked by a crimson column monument reaching toward the grey.

photo77.name: photo77.jpg
photo77.title: The Tube
photo77.description: The iconic London Underground roundel. You will hear 'mind the gap' in your sleep.

photo78.name: photo78.jpg
photo78.title: Victorian London Corner
photo78.description: Ornate Victorian architecture glowing warm against the sleek glass towers behind it. London in one frame.

photo8.name: photo8.jpg
photo8.title: Autumn Promenade
photo8.description: A leaf-strewn promenade lined with chestnut trees overlooking a European city. Peak autumn energy, zero other tourists.

photo80.name: photo80.jpg
photo80.title: Leadenhall Market
photo80.description: Leadenhall Market dressed up in Christmas baubles, looking like a portal to Diagon Alley. Because it literally is.

photo82.name: photo82.jpg
photo82.title: Tower Bridge at Night
photo82.description: Tower Bridge illuminated against the black Thames, its cables traced in white light like a circuit board.

photo83.name: photo83.jpg
photo83.title: West End Stage
photo83.description: Red velvet curtains and royal crests inside a grand London theatre. Intermission vibes.

photo84.name: photo84.jpg
photo84.title: The Walkie Talkie
photo84.description: 20 Fenchurch Street curving skyward like a building that forgot to stop growing. They say it once melted a car.

photo85.name: photo85.jpg
photo85.title: Tower of London
photo85.description: The Tower of London framed by autumn trees and pigeons who clearly run the place.

photo86.name: photo86.jpg
photo86.title: Tower Clock
photo86.description: A golden-faced clock mounted on the medieval stone walls of the Tower. Still more reliable than my phone.

photo87.name: photo87.jpg
photo87.title: The White Tower
photo87.description: The White Tower standing as it has for nearly a thousand years, stoic and unbothered by the overcast sky.

photo88.name: photo88.jpg
photo88.title: Chapel of St. Peter
photo88.description: Inside the Chapel of St. Peter ad Vincula at the Tower of London, where history whispers from every stone.

photo89.name: photo89.jpg
photo89.title: Thames Skyline
photo89.description: The Shard disappearing into the clouds and the Walkie Talkie across the river, with HMS Belfast holding down the middle.

photo90.name: photo90.jpg
photo90.title: City of London Skyline
photo90.description: The City's financial district rising behind the Tower of London walls. A thousand years of ambition in one shot.

photo91.name: photo91.jpg
photo91.title: Walking Tower Bridge
photo91.description: Crossing Tower Bridge on foot, the Gothic tower looming ahead through the blue suspension cables.

photo92.name: photo92.jpg
photo92.title: Tower Bridge Classic
photo92.description: The postcard view of Tower Bridge from the south bank. Red double-decker included, naturally.

photo93.name: photo93.jpg
photo93.title: More London
photo93.description: Glass and steel canyon near London Bridge, The Shard ghosting through the haze in the background.

photo95.name: photo95.jpg
photo95.title: Inside St. Paul's
photo95.description: The breathtaking interior of St. Paul's Cathedral, golden mosaics arching overhead. No photo does this justice, but I tried.

photo96.name: photo96.jpg
photo96.title: City from St. Paul's
photo96.description: The City of London skyline from the top of St. Paul's Cathedral on a rare blue-sky day. 22 Bishopsgate dominating the center.

photo97.name: photo97.jpg
photo97.title: Between the Towers
photo97.description: Looking out over London from St. Paul's dome, framed between the cathedral's twin clock towers.

photo98.name: photo98.jpg
photo98.title: Paternoster Square
photo98.description: Paternoster Square and its gilded column seen from above, the circular paving pattern looking like a loading screen.

photo99.name: photo99.jpg
photo99.title: Skyline Over the Balustrade
photo99.description: The City skyline peeking above St. Paul's stone balustrade under a crisp blue sky.
